title.en: Volume 91: The Arts - Chao Chong, Zhang Yuan, Yin Shao, Wang Zao, Geng Xuan, Liu Lingzhu, Jiang Shi, and others
title.raw: 卷91 術藝:晁崇 張淵 殷紹 王早 耿玄 劉靈助 江式等 Volume 91: The Arts - Chao Chong, Zhang Yuan, Yin Shao, Wang Zao, Geng Xuan, Liu Lingzhu, Jiang Shi, and others

sentences.zh: 晁崇 張淵 殷紹 王早 耿玄 劉靈助 江式 周澹 李脩 徐謇 王顯 崔彧 蔣少游[1]

translations.literal: Chao Chong, Zhang Yuan, Yin Shao, Wang Zao, Geng Xuan, Liu Lingzhu, Jiang Shi, Zhou Dan, Li Xiu, Xu Jian, Wang Xian, Cui Yu, Jiang Shaoyou [1]
translations.idiomatic: Chao Chong, Zhang Yuan, Yin Shao, Wang Zao, Geng Xuan, Liu Lingzhu, Jiang Shi, Zhou Dan, Li Xiu, Xu Jian, Wang Xian, Cui Yu, and Jiang Shaoyou [1]

sentences.zh: 蓋小道必有可觀，況往聖標曆數之術，先王垂卜筮之典，論察有法，占候相傳，觸類長之，其流遂廣。

translations.literal: For even minor arts must have something worth observing; how much more so when former sages established the art of calendrical reckoning, and former kings bequeathed the canon of divination by tortoise shell and yarrow stalks—there are methods for investigation and assessment, and lore of observation and prognostication passed down through generations. As each category was extended, the stream grew ever broader.
translations.idiomatic: Even minor arts have something worth noting, and all the more so when former sages set forth the techniques of calendrical reckoning and former kings handed down the canon of divination. There are established methods of inquiry, and prognostic lore passed from master to pupil; as each branch was extended, the tradition spread ever wider.

sentences.zh: 工藝紛綸，理非抑止，今列於篇，亦所以廣聞見也。

translations.literal: The crafts and arts are manifold, and it is not right in principle to suppress them. We now list them in this chapter to broaden what may be seen and heard.
translations.idiomatic: The crafts and arts are diverse, and there is no good reason to suppress them on principle. They are recorded here to widen the reader's knowledge.

sentences.zh: 晁崇，字子業，遼東襄平人也。

translations.literal: Chao Chong, courtesy name Ziye, was a native of Xiangping in Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Chao Chong, styled Ziye, came from Xiangping in Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 家世史官。

translations.literal: His family for generations served as court historians.
translations.idiomatic: His family had served as court historians for generations.

sentences.zh: 崇善天文術數，知名於時。

translations.literal: Chong was skilled in astronomy and numerology and was renowned in his time.
translations.idiomatic: Chong was accomplished in astronomy and calendrical arts and was well known in his day.

sentences.zh: 為慕容垂太史郎。

translations.literal: He served as Grand Astrologer Attendant under Murong Chui.
translations.idiomatic: He held the post of Grand Astrologer Attendant under Murong Chui.

sentences.zh: 從慕容寶敗於參合，獲崇，後乃赦之。

translations.literal: When he followed Murong Bao and was defeated at Canhe, Chong was captured; he was later pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: After Murong Bao's defeat at Canhe, Chong was taken prisoner and later pardoned.

sentences.zh: 太祖愛其伎術，甚見親待。

translations.literal: Emperor Daowu admired his skills and treated him with great favor.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Daowu valued his expertise and treated him with marked favor.

sentences.zh: 從平中原，拜太史令，詔崇造渾儀，歷象日月星辰。

translations.literal: Following the pacification of the Central Plains, he was appointed Grand Astrologer and ordered to construct an armillary sphere and chart the movements of the sun, moon, and stars.
translations.idiomatic: After the conquest of the Central Plains, he was made Grand Astrologer and instructed to build an armillary sphere and map the courses of the sun, moon, and stars.

sentences.zh: 遷中書侍郎，令如故。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Palace Secretariat Attendant while retaining his former office.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Palace Secretariat Attendant but kept his existing appointment as well.

sentences.zh: 天興五年，月暈，左角蝕將盡，崇奏曰：「占為角蟲將死。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tianxing, there was a lunar halo and the left horn was nearly eclipsed. Chong memorialized, saying, "The omen indicates that horned creatures will die."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Tianxing, a halo appeared around the moon and its left horn was almost fully eclipsed. Chong reported, "This omen means horned beasts will die."

sentences.zh: 」時太祖既克姚平於柴壁，以崇言之徵，遂命諸軍焚車而反。

translations.literal: At that time Emperor Daowu had already captured Yao Ping at Chaibi. Taking Chong's words as a sign, he ordered the armies to burn their wagons and withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Daowu had just taken Yao Ping at Chaibi. Treating Chong's prediction as confirmation, he ordered the armies to burn their carts and turn back.

sentences.zh: 牛果大疫，輿駕所乘巨犗數百頭亦同日斃於路側，自餘首尾相繼。

translations.literal: Cattle indeed suffered a great plague, and several hundred oxen pulling the imperial carriage died the same day by the roadside; the rest followed one after another.
translations.idiomatic: A severe cattle plague followed, and several hundred draft oxen in the imperial train died the same day by the roadside, with countless others dying in succession.

sentences.zh: 是歲，天下之牛死者十七八，麋鹿亦多死。

translations.literal: That year, seven or eight tenths of the oxen throughout the realm died, and many elk and deer died as well.
translations.idiomatic: That year, seventy or eighty percent of the oxen in the empire perished, and elk and deer died in great numbers too.

sentences.zh: 崇弟懿，明辯而才不及崇也。

translations.literal: Chong's younger brother Yi was eloquent in debate but his talent did not match Chong's.
translations.idiomatic: Chong's younger brother Yi was quick-witted and articulate, though less gifted than Chong himself.

sentences.zh: 以善北人語內侍左右，為黃門侍郎，兄弟並顯。

translations.literal: Because he was skilled in the northern dialects and served within the palace attendants, he became Yellow Gate Attendant; both brothers rose to prominence.
translations.idiomatic: Skilled in the northern dialects, he served among the inner attendants and was appointed Yellow Gate Attendant; both brothers achieved high standing.

sentences.zh: 懿好矜容儀，被服僭度，言音類太祖。

translations.literal: Yi liked to affect dignified bearing, wore garments beyond his rank, and his voice resembled Emperor Daowu's.
translations.idiomatic: Yi cultivated an imposing manner, dressed above his station, and spoke in a voice much like Emperor Daowu's.

sentences.zh: 左右每聞其聲，莫不驚竦。

translations.literal: Whenever those around him heard his voice, none failed to be startled.
translations.idiomatic: Those who heard him were invariably startled.

sentences.zh: 太祖知而惡之。

translations.literal: Emperor Daowu learned of this and detested it.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Daowu learned of this, he was deeply displeased.

sentences.zh: 後其家奴告崇與懿叛，又與□臣王次多潛通，招引姚興，太祖銜之。

translations.literal: Later a household slave reported that Chong and Yi were plotting rebellion and had secretly communicated with the minister Wang Ciduo to invite Yao Xing; Emperor Daowu harbored resentment against them.
translations.idiomatic: Later a household slave accused Chong and Yi of treason and of secretly dealing with the minister Wang Ciduo to summon Yao Xing. Emperor Daowu nursed a grudge against them.

sentences.zh: 及興寇平陽，車駕擊破之。

translations.literal: When Yao Xing raided Pingyang, the imperial forces routed him.
translations.idiomatic: When Yao Xing attacked Pingyang, the emperor's army defeated him.

sentences.zh: 太祖以奴言為實，還次晉陽，執崇兄弟並賜死。

translations.literal: Emperor Daowu took the slave's words as true. On returning and halting at Jinyang, he seized the Chong brothers and had them both put to death.
translations.idiomatic: Believing the slave's accusation, Emperor Daowu, on returning to Jinyang, arrested the Chong brothers and ordered them both executed.

sentences.zh: 崇兄子暉。

translations.literal: Chong's elder brother's son Hui.
translations.idiomatic: Chong's nephew Hui.

sentences.zh: 太祖時給事諸曹，稍遷給事中，賜爵長平侯。

translations.literal: Under Emperor Daowu he served in various offices, was gradually promoted to Palace Attendant, and was enfeoffed as Marquis of Changping.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Daowu he served in the palace offices, rose to Palace Attendant, and was enfeoffed as Marquis of Changping.

sentences.zh: 征虜將軍、濟州刺史，假寧東將軍、穎川公。

translations.literal: General Who Conquers the Barbarians and Governor of Jizhou, with acting title General Who Pacifies the East and Duke of Yingchuan.
translations.idiomatic: He served as General Who Conquers the Barbarians and Governor of Jizhou, with the acting titles General Who Pacifies the East and Duke of Yingchuan.

sentences.zh: 劉駿鎮東平郡，徙戍近境，暉上表求擊之，高宗不許。

translations.literal: Liu Jun was stationed at Dongping Commandery and moved garrisons near the border. Hui submitted a memorial requesting an attack, but Emperor Wencheng did not approve.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Jun held Dongping Commandery and shifted garrisons toward the frontier, Hui petitioned for permission to attack, but Emperor Wencheng refused.

sentences.zh: 暉乃為書以大義責之。

translations.literal: Hui then wrote a letter rebuking him on grounds of righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Hui then wrote Liu a letter rebuking him on moral grounds.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 子林，襲爵。

translations.literal: His son Lin inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: His son Lin succeeded to the title.

sentences.zh: 林卒，子清擊。

translations.literal: When Lin died, his son Qing attacked.
translations.idiomatic: After Lin's death, his son Qing launched an attack.

sentences.zh: 事在節義傳。

translations.literal: The account is in the Biographies of Integrity and Righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: The full account appears in the Biographies of Integrity and Righteousness.

sentences.zh: 暉從弟繼，太祖時稍遷中書侍郎、給事中、中堅將軍，賜爵襄平子。

translations.literal: Hui's younger cousin Ji, under Emperor Daowu, was gradually promoted to Palace Secretariat Attendant, Palace Attendant, and General of the Central Garrison, and was enfeoffed as Viscount of Xiangping.
translations.idiomatic: Hui's cousin Ji rose under Emperor Daowu to Palace Secretariat Attendant, Palace Attendant, and General of the Central Garrison, and was enfeoffed as Viscount of Xiangping.

sentences.zh: 除魏郡太守。

translations.literal: He was appointed Administrator of Wei Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Administrator of Wei Commandery.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 子世宗，襲爵。

translations.literal: His son Shizong inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shizong succeeded to the title.

sentences.zh: 卒，子元和襲。

translations.literal: When he died, his son Yuanhe inherited.
translations.idiomatic: He died, and his son Yuanhe succeeded.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 張淵，不知何許人。

translations.literal: Zhang Yuan—his place of origin is unknown.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yuan's place of origin is unknown.

sentences.zh: 明占候，曉內外星分。

translations.literal: He was skilled in observation and prognostication and understood the divisions of the inner and outer heavens.
translations.idiomatic: He was expert in celestial observation and understood the divisions of the inner and outer heavens.

sentences.zh: 自云嘗事苻堅，堅欲南征司馬昌明，淵勸不行，堅不從，果敗。

translations.literal: He said he had once served Fu Jian. When Jian wished to campaign south against Sima Changming, Yuan advised against it, but Jian did not follow his counsel and was indeed defeated.
translations.idiomatic: He claimed to have served Fu Jian. When Jian planned a southern campaign against Sima Changming, Yuan urged him not to go; Jian ignored him and was defeated as Yuan had warned.

sentences.zh: 又仕姚興父子，為靈臺令。

translations.literal: He also served Yao Xing and his son as Director of the Observational Platform.
translations.idiomatic: He later served Yao Xing and his son as Director of the Observational Platform.

sentences.zh: 姚泓滅，入赫連昌，昌復以淵及徐辯對為太史令。

translations.literal: When Yao Hong was destroyed, he entered the service of Helian Chang, who again appointed Yuan and Xu Bian as joint Grand Astrologers.
translations.idiomatic: After the fall of Yao Hong, he entered Helian Chang's service, and Chang again appointed Yuan and Xu Bian as joint Grand Astrologers.

sentences.zh: 世祖平統萬，淵與辯俱見獲。

translations.literal: When Emperor Taiwu pacified Tongwan, Yuan and Bian were both captured.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Taiwu conquered Tongwan, Yuan and Bian were both taken prisoner.

sentences.zh: 世祖以淵為太史令，數見訪問。

translations.literal: Emperor Taiwu appointed Yuan Grand Astrologer and frequently consulted him.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taiwu made Yuan Grand Astrologer and often sought his counsel.

sentences.zh: 神䴥二年，世祖將討蠕蠕，淵與徐辯皆謂不宜行，與崔浩爭於世祖前，語在浩傳。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shenju, when Emperor Taiwu was about to campaign against the Rouran, Yuan and Xu Bian both said the expedition should not be undertaken and disputed with Cui Hao before the emperor; the account is in Hao's biography.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shenju, when Emperor Taiwu prepared to campaign against the Rouran, Yuan and Xu Bian both argued against it and clashed with Cui Hao before the throne; the full account is in Hao's biography.

sentences.zh: 淵專守常占，而不能鈎深致遠，故不及浩。

translations.literal: Yuan adhered only to routine prognostication and could not probe deeply or foresee far, and so he did not match Hao.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan relied on conventional divination and lacked Hao's depth and foresight.

sentences.zh: 後為驃騎軍謀祭酒，嘗著觀象賦曰：

translations.literal: Later he served as Strategic Adviser of the Rapid Cavalry General and once composed the Rhapsody on Observing the Heavens, which says:
translations.idiomatic: He later served as Strategic Adviser to the Rapid Cavalry General and wrote the Rhapsody on Observing the Heavens, which begins:

sentences.zh: 易曰：天垂象見吉凶，聖人則之。

translations.literal: The Changes says: Heaven displays signs by which fortune and misfortune may be seen, and the sage takes them as his model.
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Changes says: Heaven displays signs revealing fortune and misfortune, and the sage takes them as his guide.

sentences.zh: 又曰：「觀乎天文以察時變，觀乎人文以化成天下。

translations.literal: It also says: "Observe the patterns of heaven to discern the changes of the times; observe the patterns of human culture to transform and complete the realm under heaven."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Look to the patterns of heaven to discern the changes of the times; look to the patterns of human culture to transform and civilize the world."

sentences.zh: 」然則三極雖殊，妙本同一；

translations.literal: Thus although the three ultimates differ, their subtle origin is one;
translations.idiomatic: Though the three ultimates differ, their subtle source is one;

sentences.zh: 顯昧雖遐，契齊影響。

translations.literal: though the manifest and hidden are far apart, their correspondence aligns like shadow and echo.
translations.idiomatic: and though the manifest and hidden realms are distant from each other, they respond to each other like shadow and echo.

sentences.zh: 尋其應感之符，測乎冥通之數，天人之際，可見明矣。

translations.literal: Seeking the tokens of responsive resonance and measuring the numbers of hidden communion, the boundary between heaven and humanity can clearly be seen.
translations.idiomatic: Tracing the signs of mutual response and probing the hidden numbers of communion, the meeting point of heaven and humanity becomes plainly visible.

sentences.zh: 夫機象冥緬，至理幽玄，豈伊管智所能究暢。

translations.literal: The mechanisms and signs are obscure and remote, and the ultimate principle is dark and abstruse—how could the wisdom of a Guan Zhong exhaust and expound them?
translations.idiomatic: The celestial mechanisms are obscure and the ultimate principle abstruse—no mere human wisdom could fully fathom them.

sentences.zh: 然歌咏之來，偶同風人，目閱群宿，能不歌吟？

translations.literal: Yet when song and verse come, one happens to be like the poets of old; gazing upon the host of constellations, how could one not sing and chant?
translations.idiomatic: Yet when inspiration comes, one becomes like the poets of old; gazing on the host of stars, how could one refrain from singing?

sentences.zh: 是時也，歲次析木之津，日在翼星之分，閶闔晨鼓而蕭瑟，流火夕暵以摧頹，游氣眇其高搴，辰宿煥焉華布。

translations.literal: At that time the year stood at the ford of Split Wood; the sun was in the division of the Wings constellation. At dawn the Gate of Heaven sounded its drum in desolation; at dusk the Flowing Fire burned withering decline. Wandering vapors soared to lofty heights, and the stellar lodges blazed forth in splendid array.
translations.idiomatic: It was the season when the year reached the Split Wood junction and the sun stood in the Wings. At dawn the Gate of Heaven beat its drum in desolation; at dusk the Flowing Fire burned in withering decline. Wandering mists rose to lofty heights, and the constellations blazed in splendid array.

sentences.zh: 覩時逝懷川上之感，步秋林同宋生之戚，歎巨艱之未終，抱殷憂而不寐，遂彷徨於窮谷之裏，杖策陟神巖之側。

translations.literal: Seeing time pass, I felt the sorrow of one standing by the river; walking in the autumn woods, I shared the grief of Master Song. Sighing that great hardship was not yet ended, I embraced deep worry and could not sleep, and so wandered in a remote valley and, leaning on my staff, climbed the side of a divine cliff.
translations.idiomatic: Watching time slip away, I felt the sorrow of one standing by the river; walking through autumn woods, I shared Master Song's grief. Sighing that great trials were not yet over, troubled and sleepless, I wandered in a remote valley and climbed a sacred cliff with staff in hand.

sentences.zh: 乃仰觀太虛，縱目遠覽，吟嘯之頃，懍然增懷。

translations.literal: Then I looked up to observe the great void, letting my gaze range far, and in the moment of chanting and sighing my feelings grew solemn.
translations.idiomatic: I raised my eyes to the great void and let my gaze range far; in the act of chanting and sighing, my feelings grew solemn.

sentences.zh: 不覽至理，拔自近情。

translations.literal: Not surveying the ultimate principle, I drew instead from immediate feeling.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to grasp the ultimate principle, I drew instead on what lay close at hand.

sentences.zh: 常韻發於宵夜，不任咏歌之末，遂援管而為賦。

translations.literal: Plain rhymes arose in the deep of night; unable to bear the end of song alone, I took up my brush and composed this rhapsody.
translations.idiomatic: Plain verses came to me in the deep of night; unable to rest with song alone, I took up my brush and wrote this rhapsody.

sentences.zh: 其辭曰：

translations.literal: The text says:
translations.idiomatic: The rhapsody reads:

sentences.zh: 陟秀峰以遐眺，望靈象於九霄。

translations.literal: I ascend a lofty peak to gaze into the distance and behold the numinous signs in the nine heavens.
translations.idiomatic: I climb a lofty peak and gaze far, beholding the celestial signs in the nine heavens.

sentences.zh: 〈陟，昇。

translations.literal: (Ascend: to rise.)
translations.idiomatic: (Ascend: to rise.)

sentences.zh: 遐，遠。

translations.literal: Distant: far.
translations.idiomatic: Distant: far.

sentences.zh: 九霄，九天也。〉

translations.literal: Nine heavens: the ninefold sky.)
translations.idiomatic: Nine heavens: the ninefold sky.)

sentences.zh: 覩紫宮之環周，嘉帝坐之獨標。

translations.literal: I behold the Purple Palace encircling all around and admire the Imperial Seat standing alone in prominence.
translations.idiomatic: I see the Purple Palace encircling all around and admire the Imperial Seat standing alone in prominence.

sentences.zh: 〈紫宮垣十五星在北斗北，天皇大帝一星在紫宮中，天帝位尊，故言獨標也。〉

translations.literal: (The Purple Palace rampart of fifteen stars lies north of the Northern Dipper; the Celestial Emperor star stands within the Purple Palace. Because the Lord of Heaven's position is supreme, it is said to stand alone in prominence.)
translations.idiomatic: (The Purple Palace rampart of fifteen stars lies north of the Northern Dipper; the Celestial Emperor star stands within the Purple Palace. Because the Lord of Heaven holds the supreme position, it is said to stand alone in prominence.)

sentences.zh: 瞻華蓋之蔭藹，何虛中之迢迢。

translations.literal: I gaze upon the Canopy of State in lush shade—how distant and lofty is the void at its center!
translations.idiomatic: I gaze on the Canopy of State in lush shade—how distant and lofty is the void at its center!

sentences.zh: 〈華蓋七星，杠九星，合十六星，在大帝上。

translations.literal: (The Canopy of State has seven stars and the Pole nine stars, sixteen in all, above the Great Emperor.)
translations.idiomatic: (The Canopy of State has seven stars and the Pole nine stars, sixteen in all, above the Great Emperor.)

sentences.zh: 迢迢，高遠之貌。〉

translations.literal: Distant and lofty: the appearance of great height and remoteness.)
translations.idiomatic: Distant and lofty: describing great height and remoteness.)

sentences.zh: 觀閣道之穹隆，想靈駕之電飄。

translations.literal: I observe the Celestial Passage arching high and imagine the numinous carriage flashing like lightning.
translations.idiomatic: I observe the Celestial Passage arching high and imagine the divine carriage flashing like lightning.

sentences.zh: 〈閣道六星在王良東北，天帝之所乘躡，靈駕之所由從。

translations.literal: (The Celestial Passage of six stars lies northeast of Wang Liang; it is where the Lord of Heaven mounts and treads, and the path the numinous carriage follows.)
translations.idiomatic: (The Celestial Passage of six stars lies northeast of Wang Liang; it is where the Lord of Heaven mounts and treads, and the path the divine carriage follows.)

sentences.zh: 電飄，疾也。〉

translations.literal: Lightning flash: swift.)
translations.idiomatic: Lightning flash: swift.)

sentences.zh: 爾乃縱目遠覽，傍極四維，北鑒機衡，南覩太微，

translations.literal: Then I let my gaze range far, reaching to the four corners; to the north I observe the Pivot and Balance, to the south I behold the Supreme Palace,
translations.idiomatic: Then I let my gaze range far, reaching to the four corners; to the north I observe the Pivot and Balance, to the south I behold the Supreme Palace,

sentences.zh: 〈四維，四方之維。

translations.literal: (The four corners: the boundaries of the four directions.)
translations.idiomatic: (The four corners: the boundaries of the four directions.)

sentences.zh: 機衡，謂北斗星。

translations.literal: Pivot and Balance: that is, the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Pivot and Balance: that is, the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 太微宮十星在翼軫北。〉

translations.literal: The Supreme Palace of ten stars lies north of the Wings and Chariot.)
translations.idiomatic: The Supreme Palace of ten stars lies north of the Wings and Chariot.)

sentences.zh: 三台皦皦以雙列，皇座冏冏以垂暉，

translations.literal: The Three Platforms shine bright in paired rows; the Imperial Seat gleams radiantly, casting down its light,
translations.idiomatic: The Three Platforms shine bright in paired rows; the Imperial Seat gleams radiantly, casting down its light,

sentences.zh: 〈三台凡六星，兩兩而居，起文昌，極太微。

translations.literal: (The Three Platforms comprise six stars in all, dwelling two by two, beginning at Literary Glory and reaching to the Supreme Palace.)
translations.idiomatic: (The Three Platforms comprise six stars in all, dwelling two by two, beginning at Literary Glory and reaching to the Supreme Palace.)

sentences.zh: 皇座一星在太微星中。

translations.literal: The Imperial Seat is one star within the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Seat is one star within the Supreme Palace.

sentences.zh: 皦皦、冏冏，皆星光明之貌也。〉

translations.literal: Bright and gleaming: both describe the appearance of stellar radiance.)
translations.idiomatic: Bright and gleaming: both describe the appearance of stellar radiance.)

sentences.zh: 虎賁執銳於前階，常陳屯聚於後闈。

translations.literal: The Tiger Guard holds sharp weapons on the front steps; the Ever Array gathers in force at the rear gate.
translations.idiomatic: The Tiger Guard holds sharp weapons on the front steps; the Ever Array gathers in force at the rear gate.

sentences.zh: 〈三台謂之太階，虎賁一星在下台南，故言前階。

translations.literal: (The Three Platforms are called the Grand Steps; the Tiger Guard star lies south of the lower platform, hence the reference to the front steps.)
translations.idiomatic: (The Three Platforms are called the Grand Steps; the Tiger Guard star lies south of the lower platform, hence the reference to the front steps.)

sentences.zh: 常陳七星，如畢狀，在皇座北，皆宿衞天帝前後，備非常。

translations.literal: The Ever Array of seven stars, shaped like a net, lies north of the Imperial Seat; all guard the Lord of Heaven before and behind against the unexpected.)
translations.idiomatic: The Ever Array of seven stars, shaped like a net, lies north of the Imperial Seat; all guard the Lord of Heaven before and behind against the unexpected.)

sentences.zh: 闈門，宮中之門也。〉

translations.literal: Rear gate: a gate within the palace.)
translations.idiomatic: Rear gate: a gate within the palace.)

sentences.zh: 遂回情旋首，次目文昌，

translations.literal: Then turning my feelings and shifting my gaze, I next look upon Literary Glory,
translations.idiomatic: Then turning my gaze, I next look upon Literary Glory,

sentences.zh: 〈文昌七星，在北斗魁前，別一宮之名，皆相位次也。〉

translations.literal: (Literary Glory of seven stars lies before the Dipper's head; it is the name of a separate palace, and all are ministerial stars in rank and order.)
translations.idiomatic: (Literary Glory of seven stars lies before the Dipper's head; it is the name of a separate palace, and all are ministerial stars in rank and order.)

sentences.zh: 仰見造父，爰及王良。

translations.literal: Looking up I see Zaofu, and also Wang Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Looking up I see Zaofu, and also Wang Liang.

sentences.zh: 〈造父五星在傳舍河中。

translations.literal: (Zaofu of five stars lies in the Relay Inn within the River.)
translations.idiomatic: (Zaofu of five stars lies in the Relay Inn within the River.)

sentences.zh: 造父，周穆王御，死，精上為星。

translations.literal: Zaofu was charioteer to King Mu of Zhou; when he died, his essence ascended to become a star.)
translations.idiomatic: Zaofu was charioteer to King Mu of Zhou; when he died, his essence ascended to become a star.)

sentences.zh: 王良五星在奎北。

translations.literal: Wang Liang of five stars lies north of Kui.)
translations.idiomatic: Wang Liang of five stars lies north of Kui.)

sentences.zh: 王良者，晉大夫，善御，九方湮之子。

translations.literal: Wang Liang was a grandee of Jin, skilled in driving, and the son of Jiufang Yan.)
translations.idiomatic: Wang Liang was a grandee of Jin, skilled in driving, and the son of Jiufang Yan.)

sentences.zh: 良一名郵無正，為趙簡子御。

translations.literal: Liang was also called You Wuzheng and served as charioteer to Duke Jianzi of Zhao.)
translations.idiomatic: Liang was also called You Wuzheng and served as charioteer to Duke Jianzi of Zhao.)

sentences.zh: 死，精託於星，為天帝之馭官。〉

translations.literal: When he died, his essence lodged in a star and became the Lord of Heaven's charioteer.)
translations.idiomatic: When he died, his essence lodged in a star and became the Lord of Heaven's charioteer.)

sentences.zh: 傅說登天而乘尾，奚仲託精於津陽。

translations.literal: Fu Yue ascended heaven and rides the Tail; Xi Zhong entrusted his essence to the north bank of the Ford.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Yue ascended to heaven and rides the Tail; Xi Zhong entrusted his essence to the north bank of the Ford.

sentences.zh: 〈傅說一星在尾後。

translations.literal: (Fu Yue is one star behind the Tail.)
translations.idiomatic: (Fu Yue is one star behind the Tail.)

sentences.zh: 傅說，殷時隱於巖中，殷王武丁夢得賢人，圖畫其象，求而得之，即立為相。

translations.literal: Fu Yue hid in cliffs during the Yin dynasty. King Wuding of Yin dreamed he obtained a worthy man, drew his likeness, sought and found him, and immediately installed him as chief minister.)
translations.idiomatic: Fu Yue hid in the cliffs during the Shang dynasty. King Wuding dreamed of a worthy man, drew his likeness, found him, and immediately made him chief minister.)

sentences.zh: 死，精上為星。

translations.literal: When he died, his essence ascended to become a star.)
translations.idiomatic: When he died, his essence ascended to become a star.)

sentences.zh: 乘尾，在龍駟之間。

translations.literal: Riding the Tail: between the Dragon's Team.)
translations.idiomatic: Riding the Tail: between the Dragon's Team.)

sentences.zh: 奚仲四星在天津北，近河傍。

translations.literal: Xi Zhong of four stars lies north of the Celestial Ford, near the riverbank.)
translations.idiomatic: Xi Zhong of four stars lies north of the Celestial Ford, near the riverbank.)

sentences.zh: 太古時造車輿者，死而精上為星。

translations.literal: In most ancient times the maker of chariots and carriages, when he died, ascended as a star.
translations.idiomatic: In most ancient times the inventor of chariots and carriages, when he died, ascended to become a star.

sentences.zh: 水北曰陽，在河北，故曰津陽也。〉

translations.literal: The north bank of a river is called yang; it lies on the north side of the River, hence the name Ford Yang.)
translations.idiomatic: The north bank of a river is called yang; it lies on the north side of the River, hence the name Ford Yang.)

sentences.zh: 織女朗列於河湄，牽牛煥然而舒光。

translations.literal: The Weaving Maid shines in array upon the river's bank; the Oxherd blazes forth and spreads his light.
translations.idiomatic: The Weaving Maid shines in array upon the riverbank; the Oxherd blazes forth and spreads his light.

sentences.zh: 〈織女三星在紀星東端，牽牛六星在河鼓南。

translations.literal: (The Weaving Maid of three stars lies at the eastern end of Ji; the Oxherd of six stars lies south of the River Drum.)
translations.idiomatic: (The Weaving Maid of three stars lies at the eastern end of Ji; the Oxherd of six stars lies south of the River Drum.)

sentences.zh: 世人復以河鼓為牽牛。〉

translations.literal: People also take the River Drum to be the Oxherd.)
translations.idiomatic: People also take the River Drum to be the Oxherd.)

sentences.zh: 五車亭柱於畢陰，兩河俠井而相望。

translations.literal: The Five Chariots stand like pavilion pillars in the shade of Bi; the Two Rivers flank the Well and gaze at each other.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Chariots stand like pavilion pillars in the shade of Bi; the Two Rivers flank the Well and gaze at each other.

sentences.zh: 〈五車三柱，都十四星，在畢東北。

translations.literal: (The Five Chariots with three pillars comprise fourteen stars in all, northeast of Bi.)
translations.idiomatic: (The Five Chariots with three pillars comprise fourteen stars in all, northeast of Bi.)

sentences.zh: 在宿北，故謂之陰。

translations.literal: They lie north of the lodge, hence called the shade.)
translations.idiomatic: They lie north of the lodge, hence called the shade.)

sentences.zh: 兩河，南河、北河。

translations.literal: The Two Rivers: South River and North River.)
translations.idiomatic: The Two Rivers: South River and North River.)

sentences.zh: 六星俠東井，東西遙相對，故曰相望也。〉

translations.literal: Six stars flank the Eastern Well, facing each other from east and west at a distance, hence the term gazing at each other.)
translations.idiomatic: Six stars flank the Eastern Well, facing each other from east and west at a distance, hence the term gazing at each other.)

sentences.zh: 灼灼羣位，落落幽紀，設官分職，罔不悉置。

translations.literal: The host of offices shines bright; the dark registers stand sparse; offices are established and duties divided—none are not fully set in place.
translations.idiomatic: The host of offices shines bright; the dark registers stand sparse; offices are established and duties divided—none are left unassigned.

sentences.zh: 〈灼灼、落落，皆星光明希疏之貌。

translations.literal: (Bright and sparse: both describe the appearance of stellar radiance, bright or thinly scattered.)
translations.idiomatic: (Bright and sparse: both describe the appearance of stellar radiance, bright or thinly scattered.)

sentences.zh: 羣位，謂天設三公九卿之官，皇后嬪御之位。

translations.literal: The host of offices means the offices Heaven established—the Three Dukes and Nine Ministers, and the positions of empress and consorts.)
translations.idiomatic: The host of offices means the offices Heaven established—the Three Dukes and Nine Ministers, and the positions of empress and consorts.)

sentences.zh: 分，謂分其所司，而各有所典。

translations.literal: Divided: each is assigned what he oversees, and each has his own charge.)
translations.idiomatic: Divided: each is assigned what he oversees, and each has his own charge.)

sentences.zh: 罔，無。

translations.literal: None: nothing.)
translations.idiomatic: None: nothing.)

sentences.zh: 悉，盡。

translations.literal: Fully: completely.)
translations.idiomatic: Fully: completely.)

sentences.zh: 言無不盡備，官職亦有之也。〉

translations.literal: This means nothing is not fully provided; the official posts also exist.)
translations.idiomatic: This means nothing is left incomplete; the official posts also exist.)

sentences.zh: 儲貳副天，庭延三吏。

translations.literal: The Heir Apparent assists Heaven; the court extends to the Three Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: The Heir Apparent assists Heaven; the court extends to the Three Ministers.

sentences.zh: 〈儲貳，謂太子一星，在帝座北。

translations.literal: (The Heir Apparent refers to the Crown Prince star, north of the Imperial Seat.)
translations.idiomatic: (The Heir Apparent refers to the Crown Prince star, north of the Imperial Seat.)

sentences.zh: 三吏，三公星，在太微宮中也。〉

translations.literal: The Three Ministers are the Three Dukes stars, within the Supreme Palace.)
translations.idiomatic: The Three Ministers are the Three Dukes stars, within the Supreme Palace.)

sentences.zh: 論道納言，各有攸司。

translations.literal: Discussing the Way and receiving words—each has his proper charge.
translations.idiomatic: Discussing the Way and receiving memorials—each has his proper charge.

sentences.zh: 〈論道，謂三公坐而論道。

translations.literal: (Discussing the Way: the Three Dukes sit and discuss the Way.)
translations.idiomatic: (Discussing the Way: the Three Dukes sit and discuss the Way.)

sentences.zh: 納言，謂尚書獻可替否。〉

translations.literal: Receiving words: the Masters of Writing present what is acceptable and replace what is not.)
translations.idiomatic: Receiving words: the Masters of Writing present what is acceptable and replace what is not.)

sentences.zh: 將相次序以衞守，九卿珠連而內侍。

translations.literal: Generals and ministers stand in order to guard; the Nine Ministers link like pearls in inner attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Generals and ministers stand in order to guard; the Nine Ministers link like pearls in inner attendance.

sentences.zh: 〈太微宮十星皆有上將、上相、次將、次相之位。

translations.literal: (The ten stars of the Supreme Palace all have positions for Senior General, Senior Minister, Junior General, and Junior Minister.)
translations.idiomatic: (The ten stars of the Supreme Palace all have positions for Senior General, Senior Minister, Junior General, and Junior Minister.)

sentences.zh: 九卿三星在太微庭中，行列似珠之相連而內侍。〉

translations.literal: The Nine Ministers of three stars are in the court of the Supreme Palace, arrayed in rows like linked pearls in inner attendance.)
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Ministers of three stars are in the court of the Supreme Palace, arrayed in rows like linked pearls in inner attendance.)

sentences.zh: 天街分中外之境，四七列九土之異。

translations.literal: The Celestial Street divides the inner and outer realms; the Four Sevens array the differences of the Nine Regions.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Street divides the inner and outer realms; the Four Sevens array the differences of the Nine Regions.

sentences.zh: 〈天街二星，昴畢間，近月星，陰陽之所分，中國之境界。

translations.literal: (The Celestial Street of two stars lies between Mao and Bi, near the Moon star—the division of yin and yang, the boundary of the Central States.)
translations.idiomatic: (The Celestial Street of two stars lies between Mao and Bi, near the Moon star—the division of yin and yang, the boundary of the Central States.)

sentences.zh: 天街以西屬外國，旄頭氈褐，引弓之民皆屬焉。

translations.literal: West of the Celestial Street belongs to foreign lands—the feathered-head, felt-clad, bow-drawing peoples all belong there.)
translations.idiomatic: West of the Celestial Street belongs to foreign lands—the feathered-head, felt-clad, bow-drawing peoples all belong there.)

sentences.zh: 天街以東屬中國，縉紳之士，冠帶之倫皆屬焉。

translations.literal: East of the Celestial Street belongs to the Central States—the gentry in silk sashes and the ranks of capped and belted officials all belong there.)
translations.idiomatic: East of the Celestial Street belongs to the Central States—the gentry in silk sashes and the ranks of capped and belted officials all belong there.)

sentences.zh: 四七二十八宿，角、亢，鄭國兗州；

translations.literal: The Four Sevens, twenty-eight lodges: Jiao and Kang—Zheng state, Yanzhou;
translations.idiomatic: The Four Sevens, twenty-eight lodges: Jiao and Kang—Zheng state, Yanzhou;

sentences.zh: 氐、房、心，陳國豫州；

translations.literal: Di, Fang, and Xin—Chen state, Yuzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Di, Fang, and Xin—Chen state, Yuzhou;

sentences.zh: 尾、箕，燕國幽州；

translations.literal: Wei and Ji—Yan state, Youzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Wei and Ji—Yan state, Youzhou;

sentences.zh: 斗、牛，吳國揚州；

translations.literal: Dou and Niu—Wu state, Yangzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Dou and Niu—Wu state, Yangzhou;

sentences.zh: 女、虛、危，齊國青州；

translations.literal: Nu, Xu, and Wei—Qi state, Qingzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Nu, Xu, and Wei—Qi state, Qingzhou;

sentences.zh: 營室、東壁，衞國并州；

translations.literal: Encampment and Eastern Wall—Wei state, Bingzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Encampment and Eastern Wall—Wei state, Bingzhou;

sentences.zh: 奎、婁，魯國徐州；

translations.literal: Kui and Lou—Lu state, Xuzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Kui and Lou—Lu state, Xuzhou;

sentences.zh: 胃、昴、畢，趙國冀州；

translations.literal: Wei, Mao, and Bi—Zhao state, Jizhou;
translations.idiomatic: Wei, Mao, and Bi—Zhao state, Jizhou;

sentences.zh: 觜、參，魏國益州；

translations.literal: Zi and Shen—Wei state, Yizhou;
translations.idiomatic: Zi and Shen—Wei state, Yizhou;

sentences.zh: 井、鬼，秦國雍州；

translations.literal: Jing and Gui—Qin state, Yongzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Jing and Gui—Qin state, Yongzhou;

sentences.zh: 柳星、張，周國洛陽、三河；

translations.literal: Willow star and Zhang—Zhou state, Luoyang and the Three Rivers;
translations.idiomatic: Willow star and Zhang—Zhou state, Luoyang and the Three Rivers;

sentences.zh: 翼、軫，楚國荊州。

translations.literal: Yi and Zhen—Chu state, Jingzhou.)
translations.idiomatic: Yi and Zhen—Chu state, Jingzhou.)

sentences.zh: 天有十二次，日月之所經歷；

translations.literal: Heaven has twelve stations through which sun and moon pass;
translations.idiomatic: Heaven has twelve stations through which sun and moon pass;

sentences.zh: 地有十二州，王侯之所國。

translations.literal: Earth has twelve provinces where kings and lords establish their states.)
translations.idiomatic: Earth has twelve provinces where kings and lords establish their states.)

sentences.zh: 方土所出之物，各有殊異不同者。〉

translations.literal: The products of each region's soil each have their own special differences.)
translations.idiomatic: The products of each region's soil each have their own special differences.)

sentences.zh: 左則天紀槍棓，攝提大角，二咸防奢，七公理獄。

translations.literal: To the left are Celestial Records, Spear and Club, Sheti and Great Horn, the Two Enclosures guarding against excess, and the Seven Lords judging cases.
translations.idiomatic: To the left are Celestial Records, Spear and Club, Sheti and Great Horn, the Two Enclosures guarding against excess, and the Seven Lords judging cases.

sentences.zh: 〈天紀九星在貫索東，天槍三星在北斗杓東，天棓五星在女牀東北。

translations.literal: (Celestial Records of nine stars lies east of the Coiled Rope; Celestial Spear of three stars lies east of the Dipper's handle; Celestial Club of five stars lies northeast of the Woman's Bed.)
translations.idiomatic: (Celestial Records of nine stars lies east of the Coiled Rope; Celestial Spear of three stars lies east of the Dipper's handle; Celestial Club of five stars lies northeast of the Woman's Bed.)

sentences.zh: 攝提六星俠大角，大角一星在攝提間。

translations.literal: Sheti of six stars flanks Great Horn; Great Horn of one star lies between the Sheti.)
translations.idiomatic: Sheti of six stars flanks Great Horn; Great Horn of one star lies between the Sheti.)

sentences.zh: 二咸：東咸四星在房東北，西咸四星在房西北，此星主防奢淫諂佞之事。

translations.literal: The Two Enclosures: Eastern Enclosure of four stars lies northeast of Fang; Western Enclosure of four stars lies northwest of Fang. These stars govern guarding against extravagance, debauchery, flattery, and sycophancy.)
translations.idiomatic: The Two Enclosures: Eastern Enclosure of four stars lies northeast of Fang; Western Enclosure of four stars lies northwest of Fang. These stars govern guarding against extravagance, debauchery, flattery, and sycophancy.)

sentences.zh: 七公，七星在招搖東，接近貫索。

translations.literal: The Seven Lords: seven stars lie east of Twinkling Indicator, near the Coiled Rope.)
translations.idiomatic: The Seven Lords: seven stars lie east of Twinkling Indicator, near the Coiled Rope.)

sentences.zh: 貫索為天獄。

translations.literal: The Coiled Rope is Heaven's prison.)
translations.idiomatic: The Coiled Rope is Heaven's prison.)

sentences.zh: 刑獄失中，則七公評議，理其冤枉。〉

translations.literal: When punishments and prisons are unjust, the Seven Lords deliberate and rectify wrongful cases.)
translations.idiomatic: When punishments and prisons are unjust, the Seven Lords deliberate and rectify wrongful cases.)

sentences.zh: 庫樓炯炯以灼明，騎官騰驤而奮足。

translations.literal: Armory Tower blazes bright and luminous; Cavalry Officer rears up and stamps his feet.
translations.idiomatic: Armory Tower blazes bright and luminous; Cavalry Officer rears up and stamps his feet.

sentences.zh: 〈庫樓十星在大角南。

translations.literal: (Armory Tower of ten stars lies south of Great Horn.)
translations.idiomatic: (Armory Tower of ten stars lies south of Great Horn.)

sentences.zh: 騎官二十七星在氐南。

translations.literal: Cavalry Officer of twenty-seven stars lies south of Di.)
translations.idiomatic: Cavalry Officer of twenty-seven stars lies south of Di.)

sentences.zh: 騎官典乘，故曰騰驤也。〉

translations.literal: Cavalry Officer governs riding, hence the term rearing up.)
translations.idiomatic: Cavalry Officer governs riding, hence the term rearing up.)

sentences.zh: 天市建肆於房心，帝座𥗼落而電燭。

translations.literal: The Celestial Market establishes its stalls at Fang and Xin; the Imperial Seat stands prominent, lit like lightning.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Market establishes its stalls at Fang and Xin; the Imperial Seat stands prominent, lit like lightning.

sentences.zh: 〈天市二十四星在房心北，帝座一星在天市中心。〉

translations.literal: (The Celestial Market of twenty-four stars lies north of Fang and Xin; the Imperial Seat of one star lies at the center of the Celestial Market.)
translations.idiomatic: (The Celestial Market of twenty-four stars lies north of Fang and Xin; the Imperial Seat of one star lies at the center of the Celestial Market.)

sentences.zh: 於前則老人、天社，清廟所居。

translations.literal: Before them dwell the Old Man and the Celestial Altar, where the Pure Temple resides.
translations.idiomatic: Before them dwell the Old Man and the Celestial Altar, where the Pure Temple resides.

sentences.zh: 〈老人一星在弧南，常以春秋分候之。

translations.literal: (The Old Man of one star lies south of the Bow; it is usually observed at the spring and autumn equinoxes.)
translations.idiomatic: (The Old Man of one star lies south of the Bow; it is usually observed at the spring and autumn equinoxes.)

sentences.zh: 天社六星亦在弧南。

translations.literal: The Celestial Altar of six stars also lies south of the Bow.)
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Altar of six stars also lies south of the Bow.)

sentences.zh: 清廟十四星在張南。〉

translations.literal: The Pure Temple of fourteen stars lies south of Zhang.)
translations.idiomatic: The Pure Temple of fourteen stars lies south of Zhang.)

sentences.zh: 明堂配帝，靈臺考符。

translations.literal: The Bright Hall matches the Emperor; the Spirit Platform examines the signs.
translations.idiomatic: The Bright Hall matches the Emperor; the Spirit Platform examines the signs.

sentences.zh: 〈明堂三星在太微西南角外，靈臺三星在明堂西。〉

translations.literal: (The Bright Hall of three stars lies outside the southwest corner of the Supreme Palace; the Spirit Platform of three stars lies west of the Bright Hall.)
translations.idiomatic: (The Bright Hall of three stars lies outside the southwest corner of the Supreme Palace; the Spirit Platform of three stars lies west of the Bright Hall.)

sentences.zh: 丈人極陽而慌忽，子孫嘒嘒於參嵎。

translations.literal: The Old Man at the utmost yang, dim and fleeting; sons and grandsons twinkle faintly at the corner of Shen.
translations.idiomatic: The Old Man at the utmost yang, dim and fleeting; sons and grandsons twinkle faintly at the corner of Shen.

sentences.zh: 〈丈人二星在軍市西南。

translations.literal: (The Old Man of two stars lies southwest of the Military Market.)
translations.idiomatic: (The Old Man of two stars lies southwest of the Military Market.)

sentences.zh: 星在南方，故稱極陽。

translations.literal: The star is in the south, hence called utmost yang.)
translations.idiomatic: The star is in the south, hence called utmost yang.)

sentences.zh: 慌忽，謂星細小，遠邈難見。

translations.literal: Dim and fleeting: the star is small, distant and hard to see.)
translations.idiomatic: Dim and fleeting: the star is small, distant and hard to see.)

sentences.zh: 老子曰：「忽兮慌兮，其中有象；

translations.literal: Laozi said: "Dim and fleeting—yet within it there is form;"
translations.idiomatic: Laozi said: "Dim and fleeting—yet within it there is form;"

sentences.zh: 慌兮忽兮，其中有物。

translations.literal: Fleeting and dim—within it there is substance."
translations.idiomatic: Fleeting and dim—within it there is substance."

sentences.zh: 」子二星，在丈人東。

translations.literal: The Son of two stars lies east of the Old Man.)
translations.idiomatic: The Son of two stars lies east of the Old Man.)

sentences.zh: 嘒，小貌。

translations.literal: Twinkling: a small appearance.)
translations.idiomatic: Twinkling: a small appearance.)

sentences.zh: 孫二星，在子東。

translations.literal: The Grandson of two stars lies east of the Son.)
translations.idiomatic: The Grandson of two stars lies east of the Son.)

sentences.zh: 詩云：「嘒彼小星，三五在東。

translations.literal: The Odes say: "Twinkling are those small stars, three or five in the east."
translations.idiomatic: The Odes say: "Twinkling are those small stars, three or five in the east."

sentences.zh: 」此之謂乎？〉

translations.literal: Is this not what is meant?)
translations.idiomatic: Is this not what is meant?)

sentences.zh: 天狗接狼以吠守，野鷄伺晨於參墟。

translations.literal: Celestial Dog joins the Wolf in barking guard; Wild Cock watches for dawn at the ruins of Shen.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Dog joins the Wolf in barking guard; Wild Cock watches for dawn at the ruins of Shen.

sentences.zh: 〈天狗七星在狼北，野鷄一星在參東南。

translations.literal: (Celestial Dog of seven stars lies north of the Wolf; Wild Cock of one star lies southeast of Shen.)
translations.idiomatic: (Celestial Dog of seven stars lies north of the Wolf; Wild Cock of one star lies southeast of Shen.)

sentences.zh: 天市中街主警怖，故曰吠守。

translations.literal: The central street of the Celestial Market governs alarm and fear, hence the term barking guard.)
translations.idiomatic: The central street of the Celestial Market governs alarm and fear, hence the term barking guard.)

sentences.zh: 鷄能候時，故曰伺晨。〉

translations.literal: The cock can tell the hour, hence the term watching for dawn.)
translations.idiomatic: The cock can tell the hour, hence the term watching for dawn.)

sentences.zh: 右則少微、軒轅，皇后之位，嬪御相次，尊卑有秩。

translations.literal: To the right are Lesser Supreme and Chariot Pivot—the empress's position, consorts following in order, high and low in rank.
translations.idiomatic: To the right are Lesser Supreme and Chariot Pivot—the empress's position, consorts following in order, high and low in rank.

sentences.zh: 〈少微四星在太微西南，北列白衣處士之位。

translations.literal: (Lesser Supreme of four stars lies southwest of the Supreme Palace; to the north are arrayed the positions of white-robed recluses.)
translations.idiomatic: (Lesser Supreme of four stars lies southwest of the Supreme Palace; to the north are arrayed the positions of white-robed recluses.)

sentences.zh: 軒轅十七星在七星北，有皇后嬪御之位，尊卑相次，皆秩序之也。〉

translations.literal: Chariot Pivot of seventeen stars lies north of the Seven Stars; there are positions for empress and consorts, high and low in order—all arranged in sequence.)
translations.idiomatic: Chariot Pivot of seventeen stars lies north of the Seven Stars; there are positions for empress and consorts, high and low in order—all arranged in sequence.)

sentences.zh: 御宮典儀，女史執筆。

translations.literal: Palace Mistress governs ritual; the Female Scribe holds the brush.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Mistress governs ritual; the Female Scribe holds the brush.

sentences.zh: 〈御宮四星在鈎陳左傍，此星主典司禮儀、威容步趨之事。

translations.literal: (Palace Mistress of four stars lies beside the left of Gouchen; this star governs overseeing ritual, dignified bearing, and gait and pace.)
translations.idiomatic: (Palace Mistress of four stars lies beside the left of Gouchen; this star governs overseeing ritual, dignified bearing, and gait and pace.)

sentences.zh: 女史一星在柱下史北。

translations.literal: The Female Scribe of one star lies north of the Scribe Beneath the Pillar.)
translations.idiomatic: The Female Scribe of one star lies north of the Scribe Beneath the Pillar.)

sentences.zh: 女史記識晝夜昏明，節漏省時，在勾陳右傍。〉

translations.literal: The Female Scribe records and marks day and night, dusk and dawn, regulating the clepsydra and checking the time; she lies beside the right of Gouchen.)
translations.idiomatic: The Female Scribe records and marks day and night, dusk and dawn, regulating the clepsydra and checking the time; she lies beside the right of Gouchen.)

sentences.zh: 內平秉禮以伺邪，天牢禁愆而察失。

translations.literal: Inner Peace upholds ritual to watch for wickedness; Celestial Prison restrains faults and examines errors.
translations.idiomatic: Inner Peace upholds ritual to watch for wickedness; Celestial Prison restrains faults and examines errors.

sentences.zh: 〈內平四星在中宮南，有邪媚之事，以禮正之。

translations.literal: (Inner Peace of four stars lies south of the Central Palace; when there are wicked and flattering affairs, ritual is used to correct them.)
translations.idiomatic: (Inner Peace of four stars lies south of the Central Palace; when there are wicked and flattering affairs, ritual is used to correct them.)

sentences.zh: 天牢六星在北斗魁下，有過失則懲其愆也。〉

translations.literal: Celestial Prison of six stars lies beneath the Dipper's head; when there are faults, their transgressions are punished.)
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Prison of six stars lies beneath the Dipper's head; when there are faults, their transgressions are punished.)

sentences.zh: 於後則有車府、傳舍，匏瓜、天津，

translations.literal: Behind are Chariot Depot, Relay Inn, Gourd, and Celestial Ford,
translations.idiomatic: Behind are Chariot Depot, Relay Inn, Gourd, and Celestial Ford,

sentences.zh: 〈車府七星在天津東，傳舍五星在華蓋上，匏瓜五星在麗珠北，天津九星在匏瓜北。〉

translations.literal: (Chariot Depot of seven stars lies east of the Celestial Ford; Relay Inn of five stars lies atop the Canopy of State; Gourd of five stars lies north of Beautiful Pearl; Celestial Ford of nine stars lies north of Gourd.)
translations.idiomatic: (Chariot Depot of seven stars lies east of the Celestial Ford; Relay Inn of five stars lies atop the Canopy of State; Gourd of five stars lies north of Beautiful Pearl; Celestial Ford of nine stars lies north of Gourd.)

sentences.zh: 扶匡照曜，麗珠珮珍。

translations.literal: Supporting Frame shines bright; Beautiful Pearl and pendant gems.
translations.idiomatic: Supporting Frame shines bright; Beautiful Pearl and pendant gems.

sentences.zh: 〈扶匡七星在天津東，麗珠五星在須女北。

translations.literal: (Supporting Frame of seven stars lies east of the Celestial Ford; Beautiful Pearl of five stars lies north of Maid.)
translations.idiomatic: (Supporting Frame of seven stars lies east of the Celestial Ford; Beautiful Pearl of five stars lies north of Maid.)

sentences.zh: 麗桂、衣珠、珮珍，后夫人之盛飾。

translations.literal: Beautiful cassia, garment pearls, and pendant gems—the empress's splendid adornments.)
translations.idiomatic: Beautiful cassia, garment pearls, and pendant gems—the empress's splendid adornments.)

sentences.zh: 其星主皇后之服也。〉

translations.literal: These stars govern the empress's attire.)
translations.idiomatic: These stars govern the empress's attire.)

sentences.zh: 人星麗玄以閑逸，哭泣連屬而趨墳。

translations.literal: Human Star attached to heaven in leisure; Weeping linked in succession, hastening to the tomb.
translations.idiomatic: Human Star attached to heaven in leisure; Weeping linked in succession, hastening to the tomb.

sentences.zh: 〈人星五星在車府南。

translations.literal: (Human Star of five stars lies south of Chariot Depot.)
translations.idiomatic: (Human Star of five stars lies south of Chariot Depot.)

sentences.zh: 麗，附。

translations.literal: Attached: joined.)
translations.idiomatic: Attached: joined.)

sentences.zh: 玄，天，言人星近於閑逸。

translations.literal: Heaven: that is, heaven—the Human Star is close to leisure and ease.)
translations.idiomatic: Heaven: that is, heaven—the Human Star is close to leisure and ease.)

sentences.zh: 易曰：「日月星辰麗於天。

translations.literal: The Changes say: "Sun, moon, and stars are attached to heaven."
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Changes says: "Sun, moon, and stars are attached to heaven."

sentences.zh: 」石氏經曰：「人星優游，人乃安寧。

translations.literal: The Classic of Master Shi says: "When the Human Star is at ease, the people are at peace."
translations.idiomatic: The Classic of Master Shi says: "When the Human Star is at ease, the people are at peace."

sentences.zh: 」哭二星在虛南，泣三星在哭東。

translations.literal: Weeping of two stars lies south of Xu; Sobbing of three stars lies east of Weeping.)
translations.idiomatic: Weeping of two stars lies south of Xu; Sobbing of three stars lies east of Weeping.)

sentences.zh: 墳墓四星在危南。

translations.literal: Tombs of four stars lies south of Wei.)
translations.idiomatic: Tombs of four stars lies south of Wei.)

sentences.zh: 哭、泣星行列趣向墳墓，故曰連屬。〉

translations.literal: The Weeping and Sobbing stars are arrayed in rows heading toward the Tombs, hence the term linked in succession.)
translations.idiomatic: The Weeping and Sobbing stars are arrayed in rows heading toward the Tombs, hence the term linked in succession.)

sentences.zh: 河鼓震雷以𥔀磕，騰蛇蟠縈而輪菌。

translations.literal: River Drum thunders like crashing thunder; Soaring Serpent coils and winds in spiral rings.
translations.idiomatic: River Drum thunders like crashing thunder; Soaring Serpent coils and winds in spiral rings.

sentences.zh: 〈河鼓十二星在南斗北，此星昏中南方而震雷。

translations.literal: (River Drum of twelve stars lies north of the Southern Dipper; when this star is at the center of the southern sky at dusk, thunder resounds.)
translations.idiomatic: (River Drum of twelve stars lies north of the Southern Dipper; when this star is at the center of the southern sky at dusk, thunder resounds.)

sentences.zh: 易曰：「鼓之以雷霆。

translations.literal: The Changes say: "Rouse them with thunder and lightning."
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Changes says: "Rouse them with thunder and lightning."

sentences.zh: 」此之謂也。

translations.literal: This is what is meant.)
translations.idiomatic: This is what is meant.)

sentences.zh: 此星主聲音，故曰𥔀磕。

translations.literal: This star governs sound, hence the term crashing thunder.)
translations.idiomatic: This star governs sound, hence the term crashing thunder.)

sentences.zh: 騰蛇二十二星在營室北，形狀似蛇，故曰輪菌。〉

translations.literal: Soaring Serpent of twenty-two stars lies north of Encampment; its shape resembles a serpent, hence the term spiral rings.)
translations.idiomatic: Soaring Serpent of twenty-two stars lies north of Encampment; its shape resembles a serpent, hence the term spiral rings.)

sentences.zh: 於是周章高眄，還旋辰極。

translations.literal: Then I looked about in all directions and turned back toward the Pole of the Heavens.
translations.idiomatic: Then I looked about in all directions and turned back toward the Pole of the Heavens.

sentences.zh: 〈辰極，北極。〉

translations.literal: (Pole of the Heavens: the North Pole.)
translations.idiomatic: (Pole of the Heavens: the North Pole.)

sentences.zh: 既覿鈎陳中禁，復覩天帝休息。

translations.literal: I had already seen Gouchen at the central forbidden precinct; I again beheld the Lord of Heaven at rest.
translations.idiomatic: I had already seen Gouchen at the central forbidden precinct; I again beheld the Lord of Heaven at rest.

sentences.zh: 〈鈎陳六星在紫宮中，天皇大帝之所居。

translations.literal: (Gouchen of six stars lies within the Purple Palace, where the Celestial Emperor dwells.)
translations.idiomatic: (Gouchen of six stars lies within the Purple Palace, where the Celestial Emperor dwells.)

sentences.zh: 諸宮別館及天牀星，皆是休息寢臥而游也。〉

translations.literal: The various palaces, separate lodges, and Celestial Bed star are all places where he rests, sleeps, and roams.)
translations.idiomatic: The various palaces, separate lodges, and Celestial Bed star are all places where he rests, sleeps, and roams.)

sentences.zh: 漸臺可昇，離宮可即。

translations.literal: Gradual Terrace may be ascended; Detached Palace may be approached.
translations.idiomatic: Gradual Terrace may be ascended; Detached Palace may be approached.

sentences.zh: 〈漸臺、離宮皆天宮臺之名。

translations.literal: (Gradual Terrace and Detached Palace are both names of celestial palace terraces.)
translations.idiomatic: (Gradual Terrace and Detached Palace are both names of celestial palace terraces.)

sentences.zh: 漸臺四星在織女東足下。

translations.literal: Gradual Terrace of four stars lies at the eastern foot of the Weaving Maid.)
translations.idiomatic: Gradual Terrace of four stars lies at the eastern foot of the Weaving Maid.)

sentences.zh: 離宮六星與營室相連。

translations.literal: Detached Palace of six stars connects with Encampment.)
translations.idiomatic: Detached Palace of six stars connects with Encampment.)

sentences.zh: 言天帝或升漸臺而觀，或就離宮而游。

translations.literal: This means the Lord of Heaven sometimes ascends the Gradual Terrace to observe, or goes to the Detached Palace to roam.)
translations.idiomatic: This means the Lord of Heaven sometimes ascends the Gradual Terrace to observe, or goes to the Detached Palace to roam.)

sentences.zh: 即，就也，禮記曰「即宮于宗周」也。〉

translations.literal: Approach: to go to; the Book of Rites says "he took up residence in the palace at Zongzhou.")
translations.idiomatic: Approach: to go to; the Book of Rites says "he took up residence in the palace at Zongzhou.")

sentences.zh: 酒旗建醇醪之旌，女牀列窈窕之色。

translations.literal: Wine Banner raises the standard of fine wine; Woman's Bed arrays the grace of fair maidens.
translations.idiomatic: Wine Banner raises the standard of fine wine; Woman's Bed arrays the grace of fair maidens.

sentences.zh: 〈酒旗三星在軒轅左角，天設置酒官為飲燕之事，故建牙旗為標。

translations.literal: (Wine Banner of three stars lies at the left horn of Chariot Pivot; Heaven established a wine office for feasting and banqueting, hence the banner is raised as a marker.)
translations.idiomatic: (Wine Banner of three stars lies at the left horn of Chariot Pivot; Heaven established a wine office for feasting and banqueting, hence the banner is raised as a marker.)

sentences.zh: 女牀三星在紀星東北端，奉侍天王之女。

translations.literal: Woman's Bed of three stars lies at the northeastern end of Ji; they attend the daughters of the Lord of Heaven.)
translations.idiomatic: Woman's Bed of three stars lies at the northeastern end of Ji; they attend the daughters of the Lord of Heaven.)

sentences.zh: 侍衞天王，必有關睢窈窕之美，無妬忌之心，乃可侍衞天王左右，故言列窈窕之色也。〉

translations.literal: To attend the Lord of Heaven, one must have the fair grace of Guan Ju and be free of jealousy—only then may one attend at the Lord of Heaven's side; hence the reference to arraying fair grace.)
translations.idiomatic: To attend the Lord of Heaven, one must have the fair grace of Guan Ju and be free of jealousy—only then may one attend at the Lord of Heaven's side; hence the reference to arraying fair grace.)

sentences.zh: 輦道屈曲以微煥，附路立于雲閣之側。

translations.literal: Imperial Procession Way winds and bends in faint radiance; Attendant Road stands beside the Cloud Gallery.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Procession Way winds and bends in faint radiance; Attendant Road stands beside the Cloud Gallery.

sentences.zh: 〈輦道五星在織女西足，屈曲而細小，故言微煥也。

translations.literal: (Imperial Procession Way of five stars lies at the western foot of the Weaving Maid; winding and small, hence the term faint radiance.)
translations.idiomatic: (Imperial Procession Way of five stars lies at the western foot of the Weaving Maid; winding and small, hence the term faint radiance.)

sentences.zh: 附路一星在閣道傍，言天帝出入由閣道附路。

translations.literal: Attendant Road of one star lies beside the Celestial Passage; the Lord of Heaven enters and exits via the Celestial Passage and Attendant Road.)
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Road of one star lies beside the Celestial Passage; the Lord of Heaven enters and exits via the Celestial Passage and Attendant Road.)

sentences.zh: 豫防敗傷，故言立於雲閣之側。〉

translations.literal: To guard against damage and injury, hence the term standing beside the Cloud Gallery.)
translations.idiomatic: To guard against damage and injury, hence the term standing beside the Cloud Gallery.)

sentences.zh: 其列星之表，五車之間，乃有咸池、鴻沼、玉井、天淵、建樹、百果、竹林在焉。

translations.literal: Beyond the array of stars, between the Five Chariots, lie Salt Pool, Vast Marsh, Jade Well, Celestial Abyss, Planted Trees, Hundred Fruits, and Bamboo Grove.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the array of stars, between the Five Chariots, lie Salt Pool, Vast Marsh, Jade Well, Celestial Abyss, Planted Trees, Hundred Fruits, and Bamboo Grove.

sentences.zh: 〈列宿之外謂之表。

translations.literal: (Beyond the lodges is called the outer region.)
translations.idiomatic: (Beyond the lodges is called the outer region.)

sentences.zh: 咸池三星在天潢東，鴻沼二十三星在須女北，玉井四星在參左足下，天淵十星在龜星東南，建樹、百果星在胃南，竹林二十五星在園西南。〉

translations.literal: Salt Pool of three stars lies east of the Celestial Ford; Vast Marsh of twenty-three stars lies north of Maid; Jade Well of four stars lies at the left foot of Shen; Celestial Abyss of ten stars lies southeast of the Turtle star; Planted Trees and Hundred Fruits stars lie south of Stomach; Bamboo Grove of twenty-five stars lies southwest of the Garden.)
translations.idiomatic: Salt Pool of three stars lies east of the Celestial Ford; Vast Marsh of twenty-three stars lies north of Maid; Jade Well of four stars lies at the left foot of Shen; Celestial Abyss of ten stars lies southeast of the Turtle star; Planted Trees and Hundred Fruits stars lie south of Stomach; Bamboo Grove of twenty-five stars lies southwest of the Garden.)

sentences.zh: 江河炳著於上穹，素氣霏霏其帶天。

translations.literal: River and Stream shine bright in the upper vault; white vapor drifts in mist, girdling heaven.
translations.idiomatic: River and Stream shine bright in the upper vault; white vapor drifts in mist, girdling heaven.

sentences.zh: 〈江，天江星。

translations.literal: (River: the Celestial River star.)
translations.idiomatic: (River: the Celestial River star.)

sentences.zh: 天江四星在尾北，言天江星乃炳然著見於天上。

translations.literal: Celestial River of four stars lies north of Tail; the Celestial River star shines clearly visible in the sky.)
translations.idiomatic: Celestial River of four stars lies north of Tail; the Celestial River star shines clearly visible in the sky.)

sentences.zh: 素氣者，天河白氣。

translations.literal: White vapor: the white mist of the Milky Way.)
translations.idiomatic: White vapor: the white mist of the Milky Way.)

sentences.zh: 素，白。

translations.literal: White: pale.)
translations.idiomatic: White: pale.)

sentences.zh: 霏霏然，帶著於天也。〉

translations.literal: Drifting in mist, girdling heaven.)
translations.idiomatic: Drifting in mist, girdling heaven.)

sentences.zh: 神龜曜甲於清泠，龍魚摛光以暎連。

translations.literal: Divine Turtle gleams its shell in clear cool waters; dragon and fish scatter light to reflect in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Divine Turtle gleams its shell in clear cool waters; dragon and fish scatter light to reflect in succession.

sentences.zh: 〈神龜，龜星也，有五星在尾南。

translations.literal: (Divine Turtle is the Turtle star, five stars south of Tail.)
translations.idiomatic: (Divine Turtle is the Turtle star, five stars south of Tail.)

sentences.zh: 龜知來事，故稱神。

translations.literal: The turtle knows future events, hence called divine.)
translations.idiomatic: The turtle knows future events, hence called divine.)

sentences.zh: 在河中，故言清泠。

translations.literal: It lies in the river, hence the term clear and cool.)
translations.idiomatic: It lies in the river, hence the term clear and cool.)

sentences.zh: 魚龍，謂魚一星，在尾後河中。

translations.literal: Dragon and fish: that is, Fish of one star, in the river behind Tail.)
translations.idiomatic: Dragon and fish: that is, Fish of one star, in the river behind Tail.)

sentences.zh: 尾為龍宿，故言龍魚。

translations.literal: Tail is the dragon lodge, hence dragon and fish.)
translations.idiomatic: Tail is the dragon lodge, hence dragon and fish.)

sentences.zh: 此星在河中，以魚星之映，水有光曜也。〉

translations.literal: This star lies in the river; reflected by the Fish star, the water has a luminous glow.)
translations.idiomatic: This star lies in the river; reflected by the Fish star, the water has a luminous glow.)

sentences.zh: 又有南門、鼓吹，器府之官，奏彼絲竹，為帝娛歡。

translations.literal: There are also Southern Gate and Drum and Pipe, the Instrument Storehouse offices, playing string and bamboo music to delight the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: There are also Southern Gate and Drum and Pipe, the Instrument Storehouse offices, playing string and bamboo music to delight the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 〈南門、鼓吹二星在庫樓南，翼西南。

translations.literal: (Southern Gate and Drum and Pipe of two stars lie south of Armory Tower, southwest of Wings.)
translations.idiomatic: (Southern Gate and Drum and Pipe of two stars lie south of Armory Tower, southwest of Wings.)

sentences.zh: 器府三十二星在軫南。

translations.literal: Instrument Storehouse of thirty-two stars lies south of Chariot Shaft.)
translations.idiomatic: Instrument Storehouse of thirty-two stars lies south of Chariot Shaft.)

sentences.zh: 器府典掌絲竹之事，以娛樂天帝也。〉

translations.literal: Instrument Storehouse governs string and bamboo affairs to entertain the Lord of Heaven.)
translations.idiomatic: Instrument Storehouse governs string and bamboo affairs to entertain the Lord of Heaven.)

sentences.zh: 熊、羆綿絡於天際，虎、豹儵煜而暉爛。

translations.literal: Bear and brown bear spread across the sky's edge; tiger and leopard flash bright and blaze with light.
translations.idiomatic: Bear and brown bear spread across the sky's edge; tiger and leopard flash bright and blaze with light.

sentences.zh: 〈虎、豹、熊、羆四星在狼星傍。〉

translations.literal: (Tiger, Leopard, Bear, and Brown Bear of four stars lie beside the Wolf star.)
translations.idiomatic: (Tiger, Leopard, Bear, and Brown Bear of four stars lie beside the Wolf star.)

sentences.zh: 弧精引弓以持滿，狼星搖動於霄端。

translations.literal: Bow Spirit draws the bow to full draw; Wolf star quivers at the edge of the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Bow Spirit draws the bow to full draw; Wolf star quivers at the edge of the sky.

sentences.zh: 〈狼一星在參東南，弧九星在狼東南。

translations.literal: (Wolf of one star lies southeast of Shen; Bow of nine stars lies southeast of Wolf.)
translations.idiomatic: (Wolf of one star lies southeast of Shen; Bow of nine stars lies southeast of Wolf.)

sentences.zh: 星傳云：「天下兵起，則弧弓張天。」〉

translations.literal: The Star Canon says: "When warfare rises under heaven, the bow is drawn across the sky.")
translations.idiomatic: The Star Canon says: "When warfare rises under heaven, the bow is drawn across the sky.")

sentences.zh: 其外則有燕、秦、齊、趙，列國之名。

translations.literal: Beyond them are Yan, Qin, Qi, and Zhao—the names of the feudal states.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond them are Yan, Qin, Qi, and Zhao—the names of the feudal states.

sentences.zh: 〈外，謂列宿之外，復有諸國之名。

translations.literal: (Beyond: outside the lodges, there are again the names of various states.)
translations.idiomatic: (Beyond: outside the lodges, there are again the names of various states.)

sentences.zh: 齊一星在九坎東，趙二星在齊北，鄭一星在趙北，越一星在鄭北，周二星在越東，秦二星在周東，代二星在秦南，晉一星在代南，韓一星在晉西，魏一星在韓北，楚一星在韓西，燕一星在楚南。

translations.literal: Qi of one star lies east of Nine Pitfalls; Zhao of two stars lies north of Qi; Zheng of one star lies north of Zhao; Yue of one star lies north of Zheng; Zhou of two stars lies east of Yue; Qin of two stars lies east of Zhou; Dai of two stars lies south of Qin; Jin of one star lies south of Dai; Han of one star lies west of Jin; Wei of one star lies north of Han; Chu of one star lies west of Han; Yan of one star lies south of Chu.)
translations.idiomatic: Qi of one star lies east of Nine Pitfalls; Zhao of two stars lies north of Qi; Zheng of one star lies north of Zhao; Yue of one star lies north of Zheng; Zhou of two stars lies east of Yue; Qin of two stars lies east of Zhou; Dai of two stars lies south of Qin; Jin of one star lies south of Dai; Han of one star lies west of Jin; Wei of one star lies north of Han; Chu of one star lies west of Han; Yan of one star lies south of Chu.)

sentences.zh: 諸列國之名，凡有十二星也。〉

translations.literal: The names of the various feudal states comprise twelve stars in all.)
translations.idiomatic: The names of the various feudal states comprise twelve stars in all.)

sentences.zh: 雷電霹靂，雨落雲征。

translations.literal: Thunder and lightning, crashing thunder; rain falls and clouds march.
translations.idiomatic: Thunder and lightning, crashing thunder; rain falls and clouds march.

sentences.zh: 〈征，行也。

translations.literal: (March: to move.)
translations.idiomatic: (March: to move.)

translations.literal: Thunder and Lightning of six stars lies south of Encampment; Crashing Thunder of five stars lies southwest of Senior Duke; Cloud and Rain of four stars lies south of Crashing Thunder.)
translations.idiomatic: Thunder and Lightning of six stars lies south of Encampment; Crashing Thunder of five stars lies southwest of Senior Duke; Cloud and Rain of four stars lies south of Crashing Thunder.)

sentences.zh: 陳車策駕於氐南，天駟騁步於太清。

translations.literal: Arrayed Chariots harness and drive south of Di; Celestial Team gallops in the Great Clarity.
translations.idiomatic: Arrayed Chariots harness and drive south of Di; Celestial Team gallops in the Great Clarity.

sentences.zh: 〈陳車三星在氐南。

translations.literal: (Arrayed Chariots of three stars lies south of Di.)
translations.idiomatic: (Arrayed Chariots of three stars lies south of Di.)

sentences.zh: 房星一名天駟。〉

translations.literal: Fang star is also called Celestial Team.)
translations.idiomatic: Fang star is also called Celestial Team.)

sentences.zh: 園苑周回以曲列，倉廩區別而殊形。

translations.literal: Gardens and parks wind around in curved array; granaries and storehouses differ in separate forms.
translations.idiomatic: Gardens and parks wind around in curved array; granaries and storehouses differ in separate forms.

sentences.zh: 〈天園十四星在苑南，天苑十六星在昴、畢南，天倉六星在婁南，天廩四星在昴南，言形象殊別不同也。〉

translations.literal: (Celestial Garden of fourteen stars lies south of the Garden; Celestial Park of sixteen stars lies south of Mao and Bi; Celestial Granary of six stars lies south of Lou; Celestial Storehouse of four stars lies south of Mao—their forms differ and are not the same.)
translations.idiomatic: (Celestial Garden of fourteen stars lies south of the Garden; Celestial Park of sixteen stars lies south of Mao and Bi; Celestial Granary of six stars lies south of Lou; Celestial Storehouse of four stars lies south of Mao—their forms differ and are not the same.)

sentences.zh: 內則尚書、大理、太一、天一之宮，

translations.literal: Within are the palaces of Master of Writing, Grand Judge, Grand One, and Heavenly One,
translations.idiomatic: Within are the palaces of Master of Writing, Grand Judge, Grand One, and Heavenly One,

sentences.zh: 〈尚書五星在紫微宮門內東南維。

translations.literal: (Master of Writing of five stars lies within the Purple Palace gate at the southeast corner.)
translations.idiomatic: (Master of Writing of five stars lies within the Purple Palace gate at the southeast corner.)

sentences.zh: 大理二星在紫微宮中。

translations.literal: Grand Judge of two stars lies within the Purple Palace.)
translations.idiomatic: Grand Judge of two stars lies within the Purple Palace.)

sentences.zh: 太一、天一各一星，相近，在紫宮門南。〉

translations.literal: Grand One and Heavenly One, one star each, lie close together south of the Purple Palace gate.)
translations.idiomatic: Grand One and Heavenly One, one star each, lie close together south of the Purple Palace gate.)

sentences.zh: 柱下著術，傳示無窮。

translations.literal: Scribe Beneath the Pillar records techniques, transmitting them without end.
translations.idiomatic: Scribe Beneath the Pillar records techniques, transmitting them without end.

sentences.zh: 〈柱下史一星，在北極東。〉

translations.literal: (Scribe Beneath the Pillar of one star lies east of the North Pole.)
translations.idiomatic: (Scribe Beneath the Pillar of one star lies east of the North Pole.)

sentences.zh: 六甲候大帝之所須，內厨進御膳於皇躬。

translations.literal: Six Jia attend to what the Great Emperor requires; Inner Kitchen presents imperial fare to the royal person.
translations.idiomatic: Six Jia attend to what the Great Emperor requires; Inner Kitchen presents imperial fare to the royal person.

sentences.zh: 〈六甲在華蓋下，內廚二星在紫宮西南角外。〉

translations.literal: (Six Jia lie beneath the Canopy of State; Inner Kitchen of two stars lies outside the southwest corner of the Purple Palace.)
translations.idiomatic: (Six Jia lie beneath the Canopy of State; Inner Kitchen of two stars lies outside the southwest corner of the Purple Palace.)

sentences.zh: 天船橫漢以普濟，積水候災于其中。

translations.literal: Celestial Boat crosses the Milky Way to give universal aid; Accumulated Water watches for disaster within it.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Boat crosses the Milky Way to give universal aid; Accumulated Water watches for disaster within it.

sentences.zh: 〈天船九星在大陵北，積水一星在天船中。〉

translations.literal: (Celestial Boat of nine stars lies north of Great Tomb; Accumulated Water of one star lies within Celestial Boat.)
translations.idiomatic: (Celestial Boat of nine stars lies north of Great Tomb; Accumulated Water of one star lies within Celestial Boat.)

sentences.zh: 陰德播洪施以恤不足，四輔翼皇極而闡玄風。

translations.literal: Hidden Virtue spreads great bounty to relieve the needy; Four Assistants flank the imperial pivot and expound the celestial teaching.
translations.idiomatic: Hidden Virtue spreads great bounty to relieve the needy; Four Assistants flank the imperial pivot and expound the celestial teaching.

sentences.zh: 〈陰德二星在尚書西，四輔四星俠北極。

translations.literal: (Hidden Virtue of two stars lies west of Master of Writing; Four Assistants of four stars flank the North Pole.)
translations.idiomatic: (Hidden Virtue of two stars lies west of Master of Writing; Four Assistants of four stars flank the North Pole.)

sentences.zh: 播，布。

translations.literal: Spread: to distribute.)
translations.idiomatic: Spread: to distribute.)

sentences.zh: 洪，大。

translations.literal: Great: large.)
translations.idiomatic: Great: large.)

sentences.zh: 玄，天也。

translations.literal: Celestial: heaven.)
translations.idiomatic: Celestial: heaven.)

sentences.zh: 陰德之官必有陽報。

translations.literal: The office of Hidden Virtue must have a yang recompense.)
translations.idiomatic: The office of Hidden Virtue must have a yang recompense.)

sentences.zh: 夫陰施陽報，自然之常數；

translations.literal: Hidden giving and open reward are the constant numbers of nature;
translations.idiomatic: Hidden giving and open reward are the constant numbers of nature;

sentences.zh: 貧窮困死，生民之極艱。

translations.literal: poverty, hardship, and death by starvation are the utmost trials of the people.)
translations.idiomatic: poverty, hardship, and death by starvation are the utmost trials of the people.)

sentences.zh: 以至困乏□死，遭陰德之終。

translations.literal: To reach such destitution and □ death is to encounter the end of Hidden Virtue.)
translations.idiomatic: To reach such destitution and □ death is to encounter the end of Hidden Virtue.)

sentences.zh: 故窮者不希周恤而惠與自至，施者無求於報而酬答自來。

translations.literal: Thus the destitute need not hope for relief yet bounty comes of itself; the giver seeks no reward yet recompense comes unbidden.)
translations.idiomatic: Thus the destitute need not hope for relief yet bounty comes of itself; the giver seeks no reward yet recompense comes unbidden.)

sentences.zh: 斯乃冥中之理，大象豈虛構其曜哉？

translations.literal: This is the principle within the hidden realm—would the great signs vainly fabricate their radiance?
translations.idiomatic: This is the principle within the hidden realm—would the great signs vainly fabricate their radiance?

sentences.zh: 四輔星既翼佐北極之樞，又能闡揚天帝之風教，故言闡玄風也。〉

translations.literal: The Four Assistants stars both flank and assist the pivot of the North Pole and can expound and spread the Lord of Heaven's teachings, hence the term expounding the celestial teaching.)
translations.idiomatic: The Four Assistants stars both flank and assist the pivot of the North Pole and can expound and spread the Lord of Heaven's teachings, hence the term expounding the celestial teaching.)

sentences.zh: 恢恢太虛，寥寥帝庭。

translations.literal: Vast is the great void; spacious is the imperial court.
translations.idiomatic: Vast is the great void; spacious is the imperial court.

sentences.zh: 〈恢恢、寥寥，皆廣大清虛之貌。

translations.literal: (Vast and spacious: both describe the appearance of broadness and clear emptiness.)
translations.idiomatic: (Vast and spacious: both describe the appearance of broadness and clear emptiness.)

sentences.zh: 老子曰：「天網恢恢，疏而不失。

translations.literal: Laozi said: "Heaven's net is vast; though sparse, nothing escapes it."
translations.idiomatic: Laozi said: "Heaven's net is vast; though sparse, nothing escapes it."

translations.idiomatic: Emperor refers to the Supreme Palace.)

sentences.zh: 五座並設，爰集神靈。

translations.literal: Five thrones are all established; numinous spirits gather here.
translations.idiomatic: Five thrones are all established; numinous spirits gather here.

sentences.zh: 〈五座，謂太微宮中五帝座也。

translations.literal: (Five thrones: the seats of the Five Emperors within the Supreme Palace.)
translations.idiomatic: (Five thrones: the seats of the Five Emperors within the Supreme Palace.)

sentences.zh: 黃帝靈威仰位東方，[3]赤帝赤熛怒位南方，白帝白招矩位西方，黑帝汁光紀位北方，黃帝含樞紐位中央。

translations.literal: Yellow Emperor Lingweiyang holds the east; [3] Red Emperor Chibinu holds the south; White Emperor Baizhaoju holds the west; Black Emperor Zhiguangji holds the north; Yellow Emperor Hanshuniu holds the center.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow Emperor Lingweiyang holds the east; [3] Red Emperor Chibinu holds the south; White Emperor Baizhaoju holds the west; Black Emperor Zhiguangji holds the north; Yellow Emperor Hanshuniu holds the center.

sentences.zh: 五帝各異，並集諸神之宮，與之謀國事。

translations.literal: The Five Emperors each differ, all gathering at the palace of the spirits to deliberate on state affairs with them.)
translations.idiomatic: The Five Emperors each differ, all gathering at the palace of the spirits to deliberate on state affairs with them.)

sentences.zh: 孝經援神契曰：「並設神靈集謀。

translations.literal: The Apocryphal Text on Divine Accord of the Classic of Filial Piety says: "Thrones are established and spirits gather to deliberate."
translations.idiomatic: The Apocryphal Text on Divine Accord of the Classic of Filial Piety says: "Thrones are established and spirits gather to deliberate."
