translations.literal: Then he commanded Sparkling Deluder to watch those who are arrogant and excessive.
translations.idiomatic: Then he commanded Sparkling Deluder to watch those who are arrogant and excessive.

sentences.zh: 〈熒惑常以十月、十一月入太微，受制伺無道之國，故曰伺彼驕盈也。〉

translations.literal: (Sparkling Deluder usually enters the Supreme Palace in the tenth and eleventh months, constrained to watch over lawless states, hence the term watching those who are arrogant and excessive.)
translations.idiomatic: (Sparkling Deluder usually enters the Supreme Palace in the tenth and eleventh months, constrained to watch over lawless states, hence the term watching those who are arrogant and excessive.)

sentences.zh: 執法刺舉於南端，五侯議疑於水衡。

translations.literal: Law Enforcement investigates and reports at the southern gate; the Five Marquises deliberate on doubtful cases at the Water Balance.
translations.idiomatic: Law Enforcement investigates and reports at the southern gate; the Five Marquises deliberate on doubtful cases at the Water Balance.

sentences.zh: 〈太微南門，謂之執法。

translations.literal: (The southern gate of the Supreme Palace is called Law Enforcement.
translations.idiomatic: (The southern gate of the Supreme Palace is called Law Enforcement.

sentences.zh: 刺舉者，刺姦惡，舉有功。

translations.literal: Investigate and report: to expose wickedness and recommend merit.)
translations.idiomatic: Investigate and report: to expose wickedness and recommend merit.)

sentences.zh: 五侯五星在東北。

translations.literal: The Five Marquises of five stars lie in the northeast.)
translations.idiomatic: The Five Marquises of five stars lie in the northeast.)

sentences.zh: 東井為水衡，辨疑獄，五侯議而評之也。〉

translations.literal: Eastern Well is the Water Balance, judging doubtful cases; the Five Marquises deliberate and assess them.)
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Well is the Water Balance, judging doubtful cases; the Five Marquises deliberate and assess them.)

sentences.zh: 金、火時出以成緯，七宿匡衞而為經。

translations.literal: Metal and Fire appear at times to form the weft; seven lodges guard and support as the warp.
translations.idiomatic: Metal and Fire appear at times to form the weft; seven lodges guard and support as the warp.

sentences.zh: 〈金、火，熒惑、太白也。

translations.literal: (Metal and Fire: Sparkling Deluder and Great White.)
translations.idiomatic: (Metal and Fire: Sparkling Deluder and Great White.)

sentences.zh: 七宿，謂一方七宿。

translations.literal: Seven lodges: the seven lodges of one direction.)
translations.idiomatic: Seven lodges: the seven lodges of one direction.)

translations.literal: In astronomy the five planets are called the weft and the twenty-eight lodges the warp; thus by mentioning Metal, Fire, and seven lodges, the five planets and twenty-eight lodges may be understood.)
translations.idiomatic: In astronomy the five planets are called the weft and the twenty-eight lodges the warp; thus by mentioning Metal, Fire, and seven lodges, the five planets and twenty-eight lodges may be understood.)

sentences.zh: 言五星出入，伏見有時，不常出也。〉

translations.literal: This means the five planets rise and set, hide and appear at fixed times, and do not always emerge.)
translations.idiomatic: This means the five planets rise and set, hide and appear at fixed times, and do not always emerge.)

sentences.zh: 暐曄昱其並曜，粲若三春之榮。

translations.literal: Bright and luminous they shine together, splendid as the glory of late spring.
translations.idiomatic: Bright and luminous they shine together, splendid as the glory of late spring.

sentences.zh: 〈言星辰布曜，若春日之榮華也。〉

translations.literal: (This means the stars spread their radiance like the splendor of spring.)
translations.idiomatic: (This means the stars spread their radiance like the splendor of spring.)

sentences.zh: 覩夫天官之羅布，故作則於華京。

translations.literal: Seeing the celestial offices spread in array, kings therefore take them as models for the splendid capital.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing the celestial offices spread in array, kings therefore take them as models for the splendid capital.

sentences.zh: 〈言天官羅布於上，王者法效於下。

translations.literal: (This means the celestial offices are spread above, and kings emulate them below.
translations.idiomatic: (This means the celestial offices are spread above, and kings emulate them below.

sentences.zh: 論語曰「惟天為大，惟堯則之」也。〉

translations.literal: The Analects says "Only Heaven is great; only Yao matched it.")
translations.idiomatic: The Analects says "Only Heaven is great; only Yao matched it.")

sentences.zh: 及其災異之興，出無常所。

translations.literal: When calamities and anomalies arise, they appear at no fixed place.
translations.idiomatic: When calamities and anomalies arise, they appear at no fixed place.

sentences.zh: 〈言災異出無常宿，隨其善惡而處之。

translations.literal: (This means calamities and anomalies appear at no fixed lodge but settle according to good or evil.)
translations.idiomatic: (This means calamities and anomalies appear at no fixed lodge but settle according to good or evil.

sentences.zh: 假使鄭國有事，則變見角亢也。〉

translations.literal: If Zheng state had trouble, the omen would appear at Jiao and Kang.)
translations.idiomatic: If Zheng state had trouble, the omen would appear at Jiao and Kang.)

sentences.zh: 歸邪繽紛，飛流電舉。

translations.literal: Returning Evil in profusion; flying stars, streaming stars, and lightning rise.
translations.idiomatic: Returning Evil in profusion; flying stars, streaming stars, and lightning rise.

sentences.zh: 〈如星非星，如雲非雲，謂之歸邪。

translations.literal: (Like stars yet not stars, like clouds yet not clouds—this is called Returning Evil.
translations.idiomatic: (Like stars yet not stars, like clouds yet not clouds—this is called Returning Evil.

sentences.zh: 夾以微氣，故稱繽紛。

translations.literal: Mixed with faint vapor, hence called profusion.)
translations.idiomatic: Mixed with faint vapor, hence called profusion.)

sentences.zh: 飛，飛星也。

translations.literal: Flying: the flying star.)
translations.idiomatic: Flying: the flying star.)

sentences.zh: 流，流星也。

translations.literal: Streaming: the streaming star.)
translations.idiomatic: Streaming: the streaming star.)

sentences.zh: 飛星與流星各異，飛星焱去而迹絕，流星迹存而不滅。

translations.literal: Flying star and streaming star differ: the flying star blazes away and its trail vanishes; the streaming star leaves a trail that does not fade.)
translations.idiomatic: Flying star and streaming star differ: the flying star blazes away and its trail vanishes; the streaming star leaves a trail that does not fade.)

sentences.zh: 電舉者，似焱電長。〉

translations.literal: Lightning rise: like blazing lightning stretching long.)
translations.idiomatic: Lightning rise: like blazing lightning stretching long.)

sentences.zh: 妖星起則殃及晉平，蛇乘龍則禍連周楚。

translations.literal: When an evil star rises, disaster reaches Duke Ping of Jin; when serpent mounts dragon, calamity links Zhou and Chu.
translations.idiomatic: When an evil star rises, disaster reaches Duke Ping of Jin; when serpent mounts dragon, calamity links Zhou and Chu.

translations.literal: (In spring of the tenth year of Duke Xiang of Lu, first month, day wuzi, an evil star appeared from Maid and was seen in the Shen quarter.
translations.idiomatic: (In spring of the tenth year of Duke Xiang of Lu, first month, day wuzi, an evil star appeared from Maid and was seen in the Shen quarter.

translations.literal: Maid belongs to Qi; Shen is Jin's allotment.)
translations.idiomatic: Maid belongs to Qi; Shen is Jin's allotment.)

sentences.zh: 梓慎見妖星出，知晉侯以戊子日死。

translations.literal: Zishen saw the evil star appear and knew the Marquis of Jin would die on day wuzi.)
translations.idiomatic: Zishen saw the evil star appear and knew the Marquis of Jin would die on day wuzi.)

sentences.zh: 蛇乘龍，謂襄公二十八年，歲星次天津，於玄枵十五度，在虛下。

translations.literal: Serpent mounting dragon: in the twenty-eighth year of Duke Xiang, the Year Star reached the Celestial Ford, at fifteen degrees of Dark Epsilon, below Xu.)
translations.idiomatic: Serpent mounting dragon: in the twenty-eighth year of Duke Xiang, the Year Star reached the Celestial Ford, at fifteen degrees of Dark Epsilon, below Xu.)

translations.literal: The Year Star governs wood, its position in the east; its body corresponds to Fang and Xin, hence called dragon.)
translations.idiomatic: The Year Star governs wood, its position in the east; its body corresponds to Fang and Xin, hence called dragon.)

sentences.zh: 虛在坎，坎子位，次玄枵，龜蛇之類。

translations.literal: Xu is in Kan, the zi position, next to Dark Epsilon, of the turtle-and-serpent kind.)
translations.idiomatic: Xu is in Kan, the zi position, next to Dark Epsilon, of the turtle-and-serpent kind.)

translations.literal: The Year Star lost its station, traveling outside Xu and emerging below it, hence serpent mounting dragon.)
translations.idiomatic: The Year Star lost its station, traveling outside Xu and emerging below it, hence serpent mounting dragon.)

sentences.zh: 龍位壽星，宋鄭之分。

translations.literal: The dragon position is Longevity Star, the allotment of Song and Zheng.)
translations.idiomatic: The dragon position is Longevity Star, the allotment of Song and Zheng.)

sentences.zh: 梓慎見蛇乘龍，知飢在宋鄭。

translations.literal: Zishen saw serpent mounting dragon and knew famine would be in Song and Zheng.)
translations.idiomatic: Zishen saw serpent mounting dragon and knew famine would be in Song and Zheng.)

sentences.zh: 然裨竈以為周王及楚子皆死。

translations.literal: Yet Pizao believed both the King of Zhou and the Lord of Chu would die.)
translations.idiomatic: Yet Pizao believed both the King of Zhou and the Lord of Chu would die.)

translations.literal: The two men interpreted the omen differently and saw different outcomes.)
translations.idiomatic: The two men interpreted the omen differently and saw different outcomes.)

translations.literal: Zishen and Pizao were fine historians of antiquity.)
translations.idiomatic: Zishen and Pizao were fine historians of antiquity.)

translations.idiomatic: Some took proof from Duke of Feng; some traced the omen to the clash at Wu.

translations.literal: (Duke of Feng: a Qi settlement, ancestor of the Jiang clan.
translations.idiomatic: (Duke of Feng: a Qi settlement, ancestor of the Jiang clan.

translations.literal: When Duke of Feng died, this star also appeared; Zishen traced the star and compared by this, knowing Duke Ping of Jin would die.)
translations.idiomatic: When Duke of Feng died, this star also appeared; Zishen traced the star and compared by this, knowing Duke Ping of Jin would die.)

sentences.zh: 衝午，謂虛宿對午。

translations.literal: Clash at Wu: Xu lodge opposes Wu.)
translations.idiomatic: Clash at Wu: Xu lodge opposes Wu.)

sentences.zh: 午為張、翼，張、翼周楚之分，裨竈占知周王、楚子死，故言推變於衝午。〉

translations.literal: Wu is Zhang and Yi; Zhang and Yi are the allotments of Zhou and Chu; Pizao divined and knew the King of Zhou and Lord of Chu would die, hence tracing the omen to the clash at Wu.)
translations.idiomatic: Wu is Zhang and Yi; Zhang and Yi are the allotments of Zhou and Chu; Pizao divined and knew the King of Zhou and Lord of Chu would die, hence tracing the omen to the clash at Wu.)

translations.idiomatic: Great waves engulfed heaven; the achievement ascended to Great Yu.

translations.idiomatic: Luyang waved his hand, and the Radiant Spirit turned back its carriage for him;

translations.idiomatic: (Luyang was a worthy man of antiquity who waved at the sun with his hand and could make it turn back twice.)

translations.idiomatic: When Yan Ling came to visit, guest qi appeared in the celestial signs.

translations.literal: (In ancient times when Emperor Guangwu was still in common dress, he and Yan Ling were close friends.
translations.idiomatic: (In ancient times when Emperor Guangwu was still in common dress, he and Yan Ling were close friends.

sentences.zh: 斯皆至感動於神祇，誠應效於既往。

translations.literal: These all deeply moved the spirits and truly responded in times past.
translations.idiomatic: These all deeply moved the spirits and truly responded in times past.

sentences.zh: 爾乃四氣鱗次，斗建辰移。

translations.literal: Then the four seasons follow in scale; the Dipper establishes and the stations shift.
translations.idiomatic: Then the four seasons follow in scale; the Dipper establishes and the stations shift.

translations.literal: Though there is no spoken word, the Three Luminaries know.
translations.idiomatic: Though there is no spoken word, the Three Luminaries know.

translations.literal: (The four seasons succeed each other without fixity; each month the Dipper shifts to establish one station; heaven has no spoken words but only shows reproof through changes in the stars.)
translations.idiomatic: (The four seasons succeed each other without fixity; each month the Dipper shifts to establish one station; heaven has no spoken words but only shows reproof through changes in the stars.)

translations.literal: Lodges at culmination are fixed at dusk and dawn; shadow measures by them are not in error.
translations.idiomatic: Lodges at culmination are fixed at dusk and dawn; shadow measures by them are not in error.

translations.idiomatic: Flood and drought are measured before they occur; the safety or peril of regions to come is prognosticated.

sentences.zh: 〈孟春正月，昏參中，旦尾中；

translations.literal: second month of mid-summer: at dusk Kang at culmination, at dawn Wei at culmination;
translations.idiomatic: second month of mid-summer: at dusk Kang at culmination, at dawn Wei at culmination;

translations.literal: third month of late summer: at dusk Heart at culmination, at dawn Kui at culmination;
translations.idiomatic: third month of late summer: at dusk Heart at culmination, at dawn Kui at culmination;

sentences.zh: 孟秋之月，昏建星中，旦畢中；

translations.literal: first month of early autumn: at dusk Establishment star at culmination, at dawn Bi at culmination;

translations.idiomatic: second month of mid-autumn: at dusk Oxherd at culmination, at dawn Zi and Zhi at culmination;

translations.literal: third month of late autumn: at dusk Xu at culmination, at dawn Willow at culmination;
translations.idiomatic: third month of late autumn: at dusk Xu at culmination, at dawn Willow at culmination;

sentences.zh: 孟冬之月，昏危中，旦七星中；

translations.literal: first month of early winter: at dusk Wei at culmination, at dawn Seven Stars at culmination;
translations.idiomatic: first month of early winter: at dusk Wei at culmination, at dawn Seven Stars at culmination;

sentences.zh: 仲冬之月，昏東壁中，旦軫中；

translations.literal: second month of mid-winter: at dusk Eastern Wall at culmination, at dawn Chariot Shaft at culmination;

translations.idiomatic: third month of late winter: at dusk Lou at culmination, at dawn Di at culmination.

translations.idiomatic: (Dark: dim.)

translations.idiomatic: Seeking far into antiquity, I sang alone with quiet ease.

translations.idiomatic: I praised the Luminous Star continuing daylight, and the great virtue of Tang Yao.

translations.idiomatic: I recalled Lü Shang's dream at night, how he ascended to assist and wing the sage.

translations.idiomatic: Searching what the charts and records note, I set down stellar changes in written contracts.

sentences.zh: 覽前代之將淪，咸譴告於昏世。

translations.literal: Reviewing former ages about to fall, all were warned in darkened times.
translations.idiomatic: Reviewing former ages about to fall, all were warned in darkened times.

sentences.zh: 〈言先代之君將淪亡，天必告災異之徵也。〉

translations.literal: (This means when former ages' rulers were about to perish, heaven always announced omens of calamity and anomaly.)
translations.idiomatic: (This means when former ages' rulers were about to perish, heaven always announced omens of calamity and anomaly.)

sentences.zh: 桀斬諫以星孛，紂酖荒而致彗。

translations.literal: Jie executed remonstrators and a broom star appeared; Zhou was debauched and wasteful and a comet came.
translations.idiomatic: Jie executed remonstrators and a broom star appeared; Zhou was debauched and wasteful and a comet came.

sentences.zh: 〈夫景星見則太平應，彗孛作而禍亂興，天之常也。

translations.literal: (When the Luminous Star appears, peace responds; when comets and broom stars arise, calamity and disorder rise—this is heaven's constant.
translations.idiomatic: (When the Luminous Star appears, peace responds; when comets and broom stars arise, calamity and disorder rise—this is heaven's constant.

sentences.zh: 昔夏桀無道，斬關龍逢而極惡，孛星見，湯伐之，放於鳴條之野。

translations.literal: In ancient times Xia Jie was without the Way, executed Guan Longfeng to the utmost evil; a broom star appeared; Tang attacked him and exiled him to the wilds of Mingtiao.
translations.idiomatic: In ancient times Xia Jie was without the Way, executed Guan Longfeng to the utmost evil; a broom star appeared; Tang attacked him and exiled him to the wilds of Mingtiao.

sentences.zh: 殷紂設炮烙之形，彗星出，武王懸之白旗也。〉

translations.literal: Yin Zhou set up the branding pillar; a comet appeared; King Wu raised the white banner against him.)
translations.idiomatic: Yin Zhou set up the branding pillar; a comet appeared; King Wu raised the white banner against him.)

sentences.zh: 恒不見以周衰，枉蛇行而秦滅。

translations.literal: Fixed stars invisible marked Zhou's decline; Crooked Arrow serpent-moving marked Qin's destruction.
translations.idiomatic: Fixed stars invisible marked Zhou's decline; Crooked Arrow serpent-moving marked Qin's destruction.

sentences.zh: 〈昔魯莊公十年夏四月，恒星不見，自是以後周室衰微。

translations.literal: (In ancient times in the fourth month of the tenth year of Duke Zhuang of Lu, fixed stars were not seen; from then on the Zhou house declined.
translations.idiomatic: (In ancient times in the fourth month of the tenth year of Duke Zhuang of Lu, fixed stars were not seen; from then on the Zhou house declined.

sentences.zh: 枉矢出，蛇行而無尾，自昔項羽入關，有此變。

translations.literal: Crooked Arrow appeared, moving serpent-like without a tail; from the time Xiang Yu entered the passes, there was this omen.
translations.idiomatic: Crooked Arrow appeared, moving serpent-like without a tail; from the time Xiang Yu entered the passes, there was this omen.

sentences.zh: 見漢書。〉

translations.literal: See the Book of Han.)
translations.idiomatic: See the Book of Han.)

sentences.zh: 諒人事之有由，豈妖災之虛設。

translations.literal: Surely human affairs have their causes—how could calamitous omens be vainly set forth?
translations.idiomatic: Surely human affairs have their causes—how could calamitous omens be vainly set forth?

sentences.zh: 〈言天以冥應，玄象為變，要由人事，豈妖災而已。〉

translations.literal: (This means heaven responds in the hidden realm and celestial signs change accordingly; the key lies in human affairs—calamitous omens are not mere omens alone.)
translations.idiomatic: (This means heaven responds in the hidden realm and celestial signs change accordingly; the key lies in human affairs—calamitous omens are not mere omens alone.)

sentences.zh: 誠庸主之難悛，故明君之所察。

translations.literal: Truly mediocre rulers are hard to reform; hence enlightened rulers examine these signs.
translations.idiomatic: Truly mediocre rulers are hard to reform; hence enlightened rulers examine these signs.

sentences.zh: 〈言庸君闇主，玄象譴告，不能改行自新以答天變；

translations.literal: (This means dark and mediocre rulers, when celestial signs warn them, cannot change their conduct to answer heaven's changes;
translations.idiomatic: (This means dark and mediocre rulers, when celestial signs warn them, cannot change their conduct to answer heaven's changes;

sentences.zh: 賢君明主則不然，見天災異，懼而修德也。〉

translations.literal: worthy and enlightened rulers are not so—when they see heavenly calamities and anomalies, they fear and cultivate virtue.)
translations.idiomatic: worthy and enlightened rulers are not so—when they see heavenly calamities and anomalies, they fear and cultivate virtue.)

sentences.zh: 堯無為猶觀象，而況德非乎先哲。

translations.literal: Even Yao in non-action still observed the signs—how much more so those whose virtue falls short of the ancients?
translations.idiomatic: Even Yao in non-action still observed the signs—how much more so those whose virtue falls short of the ancients?

sentences.zh: 〈夫唐堯至治，猶歷象璇璣，闚七政，況德不及古，而不觀之乎。〉

translations.literal: (When Tang Yao's governance was utmost, he still examined the celestial armillary and the seven regulators—how much more should those whose virtue does not match antiquity observe them?)
translations.idiomatic: (When Tang Yao's governance was utmost, he still examined the celestial armillary and the seven regulators—how much more should those whose virtue does not match antiquity observe them?)

sentences.zh: 先是太祖、太宗時太史令王亮、蘇坦，世祖後破和龍，得馮文通太史令閔盛，高祖時太史令趙樊生，並知天文。

translations.literal: Previously under Emperors Daowu and Mingyuan, Grand Astrologers Wang Liang and Su Tan; after Emperor Taiwu conquered Helong, he obtained Feng Wentong's Grand Astrologer Min Sheng; under Emperor Gaozu, Grand Astrologer Zhao Fansheng—all understood astronomy.
translations.idiomatic: Previously under Emperors Daowu and Mingyuan, Grand Astrologers Wang Liang and Su Tan; after Emperor Taiwu conquered Helong, he obtained Feng Wentong's Grand Astrologer Min Sheng; under Emperor Gaozu, Grand Astrologer Zhao Fansheng—all understood astronomy.

sentences.zh: 後太史趙勝、趙翼、趙洪慶、胡世榮、胡法通等二族，世業天官者。

translations.literal: Later Grand Astrologers Zhao Sheng, Zhao Yi, Zhao Hongqing, Hu Shirong, Hu Fatong, and others of two clans—their families for generations practiced the celestial office.
translations.idiomatic: Later Grand Astrologers Zhao Sheng, Zhao Yi, Zhao Hongqing, Hu Shirong, Hu Fatong, and others of two clans—their families for generations practiced the celestial office.

sentences.zh: 又有容城令徐路善占候。

translations.literal: There was also Rongcheng Magistrate Xu Lu, skilled in observation and prognostication.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Rongcheng Magistrate Xu Lu, skilled in observation and prognostication.

sentences.zh: 世宗時坐事繫冀州獄，別駕崔隆宗就禁慰問，路曰：「昨夜驛馬星流，計赦即時應至。

translations.literal: Under Emperor Shizong he was imprisoned in Jizhou for an offense; Assistant Governor Cui Longzong came to the prison to console him. Lu said, "Last night the relay-horse star streamed—I calculate an amnesty will arrive immediately."
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Shizong he was imprisoned in Jizhou for an offense; Assistant Governor Cui Longzong came to the prison to console him. Lu said, "Last night the relay-horse star streamed—I calculate an amnesty will arrive immediately."

sentences.zh: 」隆宗先信之，遂遣人、試出城候焉，俄而赦至。

translations.literal: " Longzong believed him first and sent someone to test by going outside the city to wait; soon the amnesty arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Longzong believed him first and sent someone to test by going outside the city to wait; soon the amnesty arrived.

sentences.zh: 時人重之。

translations.literal: People of the time valued him highly.
translations.idiomatic: People of the time valued him highly.

sentences.zh: 永安中，詔以恒州民高崇祖善天文，每占吉凶有驗，特除中散大夫。

translations.literal: In the Yong'an era, an edict appointed Gao Chongzu of Hengzhou, skilled in astronomy whose prognostications of fortune and misfortune were often verified, as Regular Palace Attendant in special appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yong'an era, an edict appointed Gao Chongzu of Hengzhou, skilled in astronomy whose prognostications of fortune and misfortune were often verified, as Regular Palace Attendant in special appointment.

sentences.zh: 永熙中，詔通直散騎常侍孫僧化與太史令胡世榮、張龍、趙洪慶及中書舍人孫子良等，在門下外省校比天文書。

translations.literal: In the Yongxi era, an edict ordered Direct Palace Attendant Sun Senghua together with Grand Astrologer Hu Shirong, Zhang Long, Zhao Hongqing, and Palace Secretariat Attendant Sun Ziliang and others to collate and compare astronomical books in the outer office under the Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongxi era, an edict ordered Direct Palace Attendant Sun Senghua together with Grand Astrologer Hu Shirong, Zhang Long, Zhao Hongqing, and Palace Secretariat Attendant Sun Ziliang and others to collate and compare astronomical books in the outer office under the Gate.

sentences.zh: 集甘、石二家星經及漢魏以來二十三家經占，集為五十五卷。

translations.literal: They compiled the star canons of the Gan and Shi schools and twenty-three schools of prognostication from Han and Wei, totaling fifty-five scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: They compiled the star canons of the Gan and Shi schools and twenty-three schools of prognostication from Han and Wei, totaling fifty-five scrolls.

sentences.zh: 後集諸家撮要，前後所上雜占，以類相從，日月五星、二十八宿、中外官圖，合為七十五卷。

translations.literal: Later they gathered essentials from various schools and miscellaneous prognostications submitted before and after, arranged by category; sun, moon, five planets, twenty-eight lodges, and inner and outer official charts—seventy-five scrolls in all.
translations.idiomatic: Later they gathered essentials from various schools and miscellaneous prognostications submitted before and after, arranged by category; sun, moon, five planets, twenty-eight lodges, and inner and outer official charts—seventy-five scrolls in all.

sentences.zh: 僧化者，東莞人。

translations.literal: Senghua was a man of Dongguan.
translations.idiomatic: Senghua was a man of Dongguan.

sentences.zh: 識星分，案天占以言災異，[4]時有所中。

translations.literal: He knew stellar divisions and, consulting celestial prognostication, spoke of calamities and anomalies, [4] sometimes hitting the mark.
translations.idiomatic: He knew stellar divisions and, consulting celestial prognostication, spoke of calamities and anomalies, [4] sometimes hitting the mark.

sentences.zh: 普泰中，尒朱世隆惡其多言，遂繫於廷尉，免官。

translations.literal: In the Putai era Erzhu Shilong disliked his many words and had him imprisoned in the Court of Justice; he was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the Putai era Erzhu Shilong disliked his many words and had him imprisoned in the Court of Justice; he was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 永熙中，出帝召僧化與中散大夫孫安都共撰兵法，未就而帝入關，遂罷。

translations.literal: In the Yongxi era Emperor Chu summoned Senghua and Regular Palace Attendant Sun An'du to compile military treatises together; before completion the emperor entered the passes and the work was abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongxi era Emperor Chu summoned Senghua and Regular Palace Attendant Sun An'du to compile military treatises together; before completion the emperor entered the passes and the work was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 元象中死於晉陽。

translations.literal: He died at Jinyang in the Yuanxiang era.
translations.idiomatic: He died at Jinyang in the Yuanxiang era.

sentences.zh: 時有河間信都芳，字王琳，[5]好學善天文算數，甚為安豐王延明所知。

translations.literal: At that time there was Xin Dufang of Hejian, styled Wanglin, [5] who loved learning and was skilled in astronomy and calculation; he was greatly appreciated by Prince of Anfeng Yanming.
translations.idiomatic: At that time there was Xin Dufang of Hejian, styled Wanglin, [5] who loved learning and was skilled in astronomy and calculation; he was greatly appreciated by Prince of Anfeng Yanming.

sentences.zh: 延明家有羣書，欲抄集五經算事為五經宗及古今樂事為樂書；

translations.literal: Yanming's household had many books; he wished to copy and compile mathematical matters of the Five Classics into a Five Classics Master and musical matters ancient and modern into a Book of Music;
translations.idiomatic: Yanming's household had many books; he wished to copy and compile mathematical matters of the Five Classics into a Five Classics Master and musical matters ancient and modern into a Book of Music;

sentences.zh: 又聚渾天、欹器、地動、銅烏漏刻、候風諸巧事，并圖畫為器準。

translations.literal: he also gathered armillary spheres, tilt vessels, seismoscopes, bronze birds, clepsydrae, wind-indicators, and other ingenious devices, with diagrams as standards for instruments.
translations.idiomatic: he also gathered armillary spheres, tilt vessels, seismoscopes, bronze birds, clepsydrae, wind-indicators, and other ingenious devices, with diagrams as standards for instruments.

sentences.zh: 並令芳算之。

translations.literal: He had Fang calculate them all.
translations.idiomatic: He had Fang calculate them all.

sentences.zh: 會延明南奔，芳乃自撰注。

translations.literal: When Yanming fled south, Fang then compiled commentaries himself.
translations.idiomatic: When Yanming fled south, Fang then compiled commentaries himself.

sentences.zh: 後隱於并州樂平之東山。

translations.literal: Later he hid on the eastern mountain of Leping in Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Later he hid on the eastern mountain of Leping in Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 太守慕容保樂聞而召之，芳不得已而見焉。

translations.literal: Prefect Murong Baole heard of him and summoned him; Fang had no choice but to see him.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Murong Baole heard of him and summoned him; Fang had no choice but to see him.

sentences.zh: 於是保樂弟紹宗薦之於齊獻武王，以為中外府田曹參軍。

translations.literal: Then Baole's younger brother Shaozong recommended him to Prince Xianwu of Qi, who appointed him Field-Camp Officer of the Central and Outer Offices.
translations.idiomatic: Then Baole's younger brother Shaozong recommended him to Prince Xianwu of Qi, who appointed him Field-Camp Officer of the Central and Outer Offices.

sentences.zh: 芳性清儉質樸，不與物和。

translations.literal: Fang's nature was pure, frugal, and plain; he did not blend with others.
translations.idiomatic: Fang's nature was pure, frugal, and plain; he did not blend with others.

sentences.zh: 紹宗給其騾馬，不肯乘騎；

translations.literal: Shaozong provided him with a mule but he refused to ride;
translations.idiomatic: Shaozong provided him with a mule but he refused to ride;

sentences.zh: 夜遣婢侍以試之，芳忿呼毆擊，不聽近己。

translations.literal: at night Shaozong sent maids to test him; Fang angrily shouted and beat them, not allowing them near.
translations.idiomatic: at night Shaozong sent maids to test him; Fang angrily shouted and beat them, not allowing them near.

sentences.zh: 狷介自守，無求於物。

translations.literal: He was aloof and self-contained, seeking nothing from others.
translations.idiomatic: He was aloof and self-contained, seeking nothing from others.

sentences.zh: 後亦注重差勾股，復撰史宗，仍自注之，合數十卷。

translations.literal: Later he also studied differential calculus and right triangles, and again compiled a History Master with his own commentary—several tens of scrolls in all.
translations.idiomatic: Later he also studied differential calculus and right triangles, and again compiled a History Master with his own commentary—several tens of scrolls in all.

sentences.zh: 武定中卒。

translations.literal: He died in the Wuding era.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the Wuding era.

sentences.zh: 殷紹，長樂人也。

translations.literal: Yin Shao was a man of Changle.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Shao was a man of Changle.

sentences.zh: 少聰敏，好陰陽術數，游學諸方，達九章、七曜。

translations.literal: From youth he was clever and keen, fond of yin-yang arts and numerology; he traveled to study in various regions and mastered the Nine Chapters and Seven Luminaries.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he was clever and keen, fond of yin-yang arts and numerology; he traveled to study in various regions and mastered the Nine Chapters and Seven Luminaries.

sentences.zh: 世祖時為算生博士，給事東宮西曹，以藝術為恭宗所知。

translations.literal: Under Emperor Taiwu he was Calculation Student Doctor and served in the Eastern Palace Western Section; through his arts he was known to Prince Gongzong.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Taiwu he was Calculation Student Doctor and served in the Eastern Palace Western Section; through his arts he was known to Prince Gongzong.

sentences.zh: 太安四年夏，上四序堪輿，表曰：「臣以姚氏之世，行學伊川，時遇游遁大儒成公興，從求九章要術。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tai'an, summer, he submitted the Four Seasons Geomancy, memorializing: "Your servant, during the Yao clan's era, studied at Yichuan and then met the wandering great scholar Cheng Gongxing, from whom I sought the essentials of the Nine Chapters.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Tai'an, summer, he submitted the Four Seasons Geomancy, memorializing: "Your servant, during the Yao clan's era, studied at Yichuan and then met the wandering great scholar Cheng Gongxing, from whom I sought the essentials of the Nine Chapters.

sentences.zh: 興字廣明，自云膠東人也。

translations.literal: Xing, styled Guangming, said he was from Jiaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Xing, styled Guangming, said he was from Jiaodong.

sentences.zh: 山居隱跡，希在人間。

translations.literal: He lived hidden in the mountains, rarely appearing among people.
translations.idiomatic: He lived hidden in the mountains, rarely appearing among people.

sentences.zh: 興時將臣南到陽翟九崖巖沙門釋曇影間。

translations.literal: When Xing was about to take your servant south to the Jiuya Cliff of Yangdi to visit the monk Tan Ying.
translations.idiomatic: When Xing was about to take your servant south to the Jiuya Cliff of Yangdi to visit the monk Tan Ying.

sentences.zh: 興即北還，臣獨留住，依止影所，求請九章。

translations.literal: Xing then returned north; your servant alone stayed behind, relying on Ying's place and requesting the Nine Chapters.
translations.idiomatic: Xing then returned north; your servant alone stayed behind, relying on Ying's place and requesting the Nine Chapters.

sentences.zh: 影復將臣向長廣東山見道人法穆。

translations.literal: Ying then took your servant to the eastern mountain of Changguang to see the Daoist Fazmu.
translations.idiomatic: Ying then took your servant to the eastern mountain of Changguang to see the Daoist Fazmu.

sentences.zh: 法穆時共影為臣開述九章數家雜要，披釋章次意況大旨。

translations.literal: Fazmu together with Ying opened and explained the Nine Chapters and various essentials of numerology schools for your servant, unfolding chapter order and main purport.
translations.idiomatic: Fazmu together with Ying opened and explained the Nine Chapters and various essentials of numerology schools for your servant, unfolding chapter order and main purport.

sentences.zh: 又演隱審五藏六府心髓血脉，商功大算端部，變化玄象，土圭、周髀。

translations.literal: He also expounded hidden examination of the five viscera, six bowels, heart, marrow, and blood vessels; commercial calculation and grand reckoning; sections and variations of dark signs; earth gnomon and Zhou bi.
translations.idiomatic: He also expounded hidden examination of the five viscera, six bowels, heart, marrow, and blood vessels; commercial calculation and grand reckoning; sections and variations of dark signs; earth gnomon and Zhou bi.

sentences.zh: 練精銳思，蘊習四年，從穆所聞，粗皆髣髴。

translations.literal: Refining essence and keen thought, practicing four years—what I heard from Mu I roughly grasp in outline.
translations.idiomatic: Refining essence and keen thought, practicing four years—what I heard from Mu I roughly grasp in outline.

sentences.zh: 穆等仁矜，特垂憂閔，復以先師和公所注黃帝四序經文三十六卷，合有三百二十四章，專說天地陰陽之本。

translations.literal: Mu and the others were benevolent and compassionate, especially showing concern; they also gave me the annotated text of the Yellow Emperor's Four Seasons Classic by Master He—thirty-six scrolls, three hundred twenty-four chapters in all, devoted to the roots of heaven and earth, yin and yang.
translations.idiomatic: Mu and the others were benevolent and compassionate, especially showing concern; they also gave me the annotated text of the Yellow Emperor's Four Seasons Classic by Master He—thirty-six scrolls, three hundred twenty-four chapters in all, devoted to the roots of heaven and earth, yin and yang.

sentences.zh: 其第一孟序，九卷八十一章，說陰陽配合之原；

translations.literal: The first, Early Sequence, nine scrolls and eighty-one chapters, explains the origin of yin-yang pairing;
translations.idiomatic: The first, Early Sequence, nine scrolls and eighty-one chapters, explains the origin of yin-yang pairing;

sentences.zh: 第二仲序，九卷八十一章，解四時氣王休殺吉凶；

translations.literal: The second, Middle Sequence, nine scrolls and eighty-one chapters, explains the waxing and waning, flourishing, resting, and killing of the four seasons and fortune and misfortune;
translations.idiomatic: The second, Middle Sequence, nine scrolls and eighty-one chapters, explains the waxing and waning, flourishing, resting, and killing of the four seasons and fortune and misfortune;

sentences.zh: 第三叔序，九卷八十一章，明日月辰宿交會相生為表裏；

translations.literal: The third, Late Sequence, nine scrolls and eighty-one chapters, clarifies the mutual generation of sun, moon, lodges, and conjunctions as inner and outer;
translations.idiomatic: The third, Late Sequence, nine scrolls and eighty-one chapters, clarifies the mutual generation of sun, moon, lodges, and conjunctions as inner and outer;

sentences.zh: 第四季序，九卷八十一章，具釋六甲刑禍福德：以此等文傳授於臣。

translations.literal: The fourth, Final Sequence, nine scrolls and eighty-one chapters, fully explains the six jia, punishments, blessings, and virtue: these texts were transmitted to your servant.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth, Final Sequence, nine scrolls and eighty-one chapters, fully explains the six jia, punishments, blessings, and virtue: these texts were transmitted to your servant.

sentences.zh: 山神禁嚴，不得齎出，尋究經年，粗舉綱要。

translations.literal: The mountain spirits strictly forbade taking them out; after investigating for years, I roughly extracted the essentials.
translations.idiomatic: The mountain spirits strictly forbade taking them out; after investigating for years, I roughly extracted the essentials.

sentences.zh: 山居險難，無以自供，不堪窘迫，心生懈怠。

translations.literal: Mountain life was perilous and I could not support myself; unable to bear the hardship, my mind grew slack.
translations.idiomatic: Mountain life was perilous and I could not support myself; unable to bear the hardship, my mind grew slack.

sentences.zh: 以甲寅之年，日維鶉火，月呂林鍾，景氣鬱盛，感物懷歸，奉辭影等。

translations.literal: In the jiayin year, when the sun reached the Quail Fire station and the month the Forest Bell pitch, the seasonal qi was lush and abundant, moved by things I longed to return; I took leave of Ying and the others.
translations.idiomatic: In the jiayin year, when the sun reached the Quail Fire station and the month the Forest Bell pitch, the seasonal qi was lush and abundant, moved by things I longed to return; I took leave of Ying and the others.

sentences.zh: 自爾至今，四十五載。

translations.literal: From then until now, forty-five years.
translations.idiomatic: From then until now, forty-five years.

sentences.zh: 歷觀時俗堪輿八會，逕世已久，傳寫謬誤，吉凶禁忌，不能備悉。

translations.literal: Observing geomancy and the eight assemblies in current custom, they have circulated long with copied errors; taboos of fortune and misfortune cannot be fully known.
translations.idiomatic: Observing geomancy and the eight assemblies in current custom, they have circulated long with copied errors; taboos of fortune and misfortune cannot be fully known.

sentences.zh: 或考良日而值惡會，舉吉用凶，多逢殃咎。

translations.literal: Sometimes one chooses an auspicious day but hits an inauspicious assembly, using the auspicious for the inauspicious—often meeting disaster and blame.
translations.idiomatic: Sometimes one chooses an auspicious day but hits an inauspicious assembly, using the auspicious for the inauspicious—often meeting disaster and blame.

sentences.zh: 又史遷、郝振，中古大儒，[6]亦各撰注，流行於世。

translations.literal: Also Shi Qian and Hao Zhen, great scholars of middle antiquity, [6] each wrote commentaries circulating in the world.
translations.idiomatic: Also Shi Qian and Hao Zhen, great scholars of middle antiquity, [6] each wrote commentaries circulating in the world.

sentences.zh: 配會大小，序述陰陽，依如本經，猶有所闕。

translations.literal: In matching assemblies large and small and narrating yin and yang, though following the original classic, there are still gaps.
translations.idiomatic: In matching assemblies large and small and narrating yin and yang, though following the original classic, there are still gaps.

sentences.zh: 臣前在東宮，以狀奏聞，奉被景穆皇帝聖詔，敕臣撰錄，集其要最。

translations.literal: Your servant formerly in the Eastern Palace submitted a memorial on this; he received the sacred edict of Emperor Jingmu ordering your servant to compile and record, gathering the essentials.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant formerly in the Eastern Palace submitted a memorial on this; he received the sacred edict of Emperor Jingmu ordering your servant to compile and record, gathering the essentials.

sentences.zh: 仰奉明旨，謹審先所見四序經文，抄撮要略，當世所須吉凶舉動，集成一卷。

translations.literal: Upholding the bright command, I respectfully examined the Four Seasons Classic text seen before, copied the essentials needed for current fortune and misfortune in action, and compiled one scroll.
translations.idiomatic: Upholding the bright command, I respectfully examined the Four Seasons Classic text seen before, copied the essentials needed for current fortune and misfortune in action, and compiled one scroll.

sentences.zh: 上至天子，下及庶人，又貴賤階級、尊卑差別、吉凶所用，罔不畢備。

translations.literal: From the Son of Heaven down to commoners, and the ranks noble and base, high and low distinctions, and fortune and misfortune used—none are not fully provided.
translations.idiomatic: From the Son of Heaven down to commoners, and the ranks noble and base, high and low distinctions, and fortune and misfortune used—none are not fully provided.

sentences.zh: 未及內呈，先帝晏駕。

translations.literal: Before presenting internally, the former emperor passed away.
translations.idiomatic: Before presenting internally, the former emperor passed away.

sentences.zh: 臣時狼狽，幾至不測。

translations.literal: Your servant was then in distress, nearly meeting disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant was then in distress, nearly meeting disaster.

sentences.zh: 停廢以來，逕由八載，思欲上聞，莫能自徹。

translations.literal: Since suspension, eight years have passed; I wish to report upward but cannot reach through.
translations.idiomatic: Since suspension, eight years have passed; I wish to report upward but cannot reach through.

sentences.zh: 加年夕齒頹，餘齡旦暮，每懼殂殞，填仆溝壑，先帝遺志，不得宣行。

translations.literal: Moreover age advances and teeth decline; remaining years are short; I daily fear death and falling into ditches and gullies—the former emperor's last wish cannot be enacted.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover age advances and teeth decline; remaining years are short; I daily fear death and falling into ditches and gullies—the former emperor's last wish cannot be enacted.

sentences.zh: 夙夜悲憤，理難違匿，依先撰錄奏，謹以上聞。

translations.literal: Day and night grieved and indignant, reason forbids concealment; following the prior compilation I submit, respectfully reporting upward.
translations.idiomatic: Day and night grieved and indignant, reason forbids concealment; following the prior compilation I submit, respectfully reporting upward.

sentences.zh: 請付中祕通儒達士，定其得失。

translations.literal: Please deliver to erudites of the Central Secretariat versed in the classics to determine its gains and losses.
translations.idiomatic: Please deliver to erudites of the Central Secretariat versed in the classics to determine its gains and losses.

sentences.zh: 事若可施，乞即班用。

translations.literal: If the matter can be applied, I beg it be promulgated for use.
translations.idiomatic: If the matter can be applied, I beg it be promulgated for use.

sentences.zh: 」其四序堪輿遂大行於世。

translations.literal: " The Four Seasons Geomancy then circulated widely in the world.
translations.idiomatic: The Four Seasons Geomancy then circulated widely in the world.

sentences.zh: 王早，勃海南皮人也。

translations.literal: Wang Zao was a man of Nanpi in Bohai.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zao was a man of Nanpi in Bohai.

sentences.zh: 明陰陽九宮及兵法，[7]尤善風角。

translations.literal: He understood yin-yang, the Nine Palaces, and military arts, [7] and was especially skilled in wind observation.
translations.idiomatic: He understood yin-yang, the Nine Palaces, and military arts, [7] and was especially skilled in wind observation.

sentences.zh: 太宗時，喪亂之後，多相殺害。

translations.literal: Under Emperor Mingyuan, after the chaos of destruction, mutual killing was frequent.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Mingyuan, after the chaos of destruction, mutual killing was frequent.

sentences.zh: 有人詣早求問勝術，早為設法，令各無咎。

translations.literal: Someone came to Zao seeking victory techniques; Zao set up methods so each would be without blame.
translations.idiomatic: Someone came to Zao seeking victory techniques; Zao set up methods so each would be without blame.

sentences.zh: 由是州里稱之。

translations.literal: For this the district praised him.
translations.idiomatic: For this the district praised him.

sentences.zh: 時有東莞鄭氏，因為同縣趙氏所殺。

translations.literal: At that time the Zheng clan of Dongguan was killed by the Zhao clan of the same district.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Zheng clan of Dongguan was killed by the Zhao clan of the same district.

sentences.zh: 其後鄭氏執得讎人趙氏，又剋明晨會宗族，當就墓所刑之。

translations.literal: Later the Zheng clan captured their enemy the Zhao clan and fixed the next morning for the clan to gather and execute him at the tomb.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Zheng clan captured their enemy the Zhao clan and fixed the next morning for the clan to gather and execute him at the tomb.

sentences.zh: 趙氏求救於早，早為占候，并授以一符，曰：「君今且還，選壯士七人，令一人為主者，佩此符，於雞鳴時伏在仇家宅東南二里許。

translations.literal: The Zhao clan sought help from Zao; Zao observed and prognosticated and also gave a talisman, saying, "You should return now and select seven strong men; let one be leader, wear this talisman, and lie in wait at cockcrow two li southeast of the enemy's house.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhao clan sought help from Zao; Zao observed and prognosticated and also gave a talisman, saying, "You should return now and select seven strong men; let one be leader, wear this talisman, and lie in wait at cockcrow two li southeast of the enemy's house.

sentences.zh: 平旦，當有十人相隨，向西北行，中有二人乘黑牛，一黑牛最在前，一黑牛應第七。

translations.literal: At daybreak ten men will follow each other, going northwest; among them two ride black oxen—the foremost black ox first, the seventh should be the seventh black ox.
translations.idiomatic: At daybreak ten men will follow each other, going northwest; among them two ride black oxen—the foremost black ox first, the seventh should be the seventh black ox.

sentences.zh: 但捉取第七者將還，事必無他。

translations.literal: Just seize the seventh and bring him back—the affair will surely have no other outcome."
translations.idiomatic: Just seize the seventh and bring him back—the affair will surely have no other outcome."

sentences.zh: 」趙氏從之，果如其言，乃是鄭氏五男父也。

translations.literal: The Zhao clan followed this; it happened exactly as he said—it was the father of the five Zheng sons.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhao clan followed this; it happened exactly as he said—it was the father of the five Zheng sons.

sentences.zh: 諸子並為其族所宗敬，故和解二家，趙氏竟免。

translations.literal: The sons were all respected by their clan; thus the two families reconciled and the Zhao clan escaped.
translations.idiomatic: The sons were all respected by their clan; thus the two families reconciled and the Zhao clan escaped.

sentences.zh: 後早與客清晨立於門內，遇有卒風振樹。

translations.literal: Later Zao stood at the gate with a guest early in the morning when a sudden wind shook the trees.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zao stood at the gate with a guest early in the morning when a sudden wind shook the trees.

sentences.zh: 早語客曰：「依法當有千里外急使。

translations.literal: Zao told the guest, "By the method there should be an urgent messenger from a thousand li away.
translations.idiomatic: Zao told the guest, "By the method there should be an urgent messenger from a thousand li away.

sentences.zh: 日中，將有兩匹馬，一白一赤，從西南來。

translations.literal: At midday two horses, one white and one red, will come from the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: At midday two horses, one white and one red, will come from the southwest.

sentences.zh: 至即取我，逼我，不聽與妻子別。

translations.literal: When they arrive they will seize me and force me away, not allowing me to bid farewell to wife and children."
translations.idiomatic: When they arrive they will seize me and force me away, not allowing me to bid farewell to wife and children."

sentences.zh: 」語訖便入，召家人隣里辭別。

translations.literal: When he finished speaking he went in, summoned family and neighbors to bid farewell.
translations.idiomatic: When he finished speaking he went in, summoned family and neighbors to bid farewell.

sentences.zh: 語訖，浴，帶書囊，日中出門候使。

translations.literal: When done he bathed, belted his book satchel, and at midday went out to wait for the messenger.
translations.idiomatic: When done he bathed, belted his book satchel, and at midday went out to wait for the messenger.

sentences.zh: 如期，果有二馬，一白一赤，從涼州而至，即捉早上馬，遂詣行宮。

translations.literal: As expected, two horses, one white and one red, came from Liangzhou; they seized Zao onto a horse and went straight to the mobile palace.
translations.idiomatic: As expected, two horses, one white and one red, came from Liangzhou; they seized Zao onto a horse and went straight to the mobile palace.

sentences.zh: 時世祖圍涼州未拔，故許彥薦之。

translations.literal: At that time Emperor Taiwu had not yet taken Liangzhou, so Xu Yan recommended him.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Emperor Taiwu had not yet taken Liangzhou, so Xu Yan recommended him.

sentences.zh: 早，彥師也。

translations.literal: Zao was Yan's teacher.
translations.idiomatic: Zao was Yan's teacher.

sentences.zh: 及至，詔問何時當得此城。

translations.literal: When he arrived, an edict asked when the city would be taken.
translations.idiomatic: When he arrived, an edict asked when the city would be taken.

sentences.zh: 早對曰：「陛下但移據西北角，三日內必克。

translations.literal: Zao replied, "Your Majesty need only shift camp to the northwest corner—in three days it will surely fall."
translations.idiomatic: Zao replied, "Your Majesty need only shift camp to the northwest corner—in three days it will surely fall."

sentences.zh: 」世祖從之，如期而克。

translations.literal: " Emperor Taiwu followed this and it fell on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taiwu followed this and it fell on schedule.

sentences.zh: 輿駕還都，時久不雨。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage returned to the capital, there had long been no rain.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage returned to the capital, there had long been no rain.

sentences.zh: 世祖問早曰：「何時當雨？

translations.literal: Emperor Taiwu asked Zao, "When will it rain?"
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taiwu asked Zao, "When will it rain?"

sentences.zh: 」早曰：「今日申時必大雨。

translations.literal: Zao said, "Today at the shen hour there will surely be great rain."
translations.idiomatic: Zao said, "Today at the shen hour there will surely be great rain."

sentences.zh: 」比至未時，猶無片雲，世祖召早詰之。

translations.literal: By the wei hour there was still not a cloud; Emperor Taiwu summoned Zao to question him.
translations.idiomatic: By the wei hour there was still not a cloud; Emperor Taiwu summoned Zao to question him.

sentences.zh: 早曰：「願更少時。

translations.literal: Zao said, "I beg a little more time."
translations.idiomatic: Zao said, "I beg a little more time."

sentences.zh: 」至申時，雲氣四合，遂大雨滂沲。

translations.literal: At the shen hour clouds gathered from four sides and great rain poured down.
translations.idiomatic: At the shen hour clouds gathered from four sides and great rain poured down.

sentences.zh: 世祖甚善之，而早苦以疾辭，乞歸鄉里，詔許之。

translations.literal: Emperor Taiwu thought well of him, but Zao pleaded illness and begged to return home; an edict permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taiwu thought well of him, but Zao pleaded illness and begged to return home; an edict permitted it.

sentences.zh: 遂終於家。

translations.literal: He died at home.
translations.idiomatic: He died at home.

sentences.zh: 或言許彥以其術勝，恐終妨己，故譎令歸耳。

translations.literal: Some say Xu Yan, because his art surpassed his own, feared it would ultimately hinder him, and so deceived him into returning.
translations.idiomatic: Some say Xu Yan, because his art surpassed his own, feared it would ultimately hinder him, and so deceived him into returning.

sentences.zh: 耿玄，鉅鹿宋子人也。

translations.literal: Geng Xuan was a man of Songzi in Julu.
translations.idiomatic: Geng Xuan was a man of Songzi in Julu.

sentences.zh: 善卜占。

translations.literal: He was skilled at divination.
translations.idiomatic: He was skilled at divination.

sentences.zh: 坐於室內，有客扣門，玄已知其姓字并所齎持及來問之意。

translations.literal: Sitting in his room, when a guest knocked he already knew the guest's surname and what he carried and the intent of his visit.
translations.idiomatic: Sitting in his room, when a guest knocked he already knew the guest's surname and what he carried and the intent of his visit.

sentences.zh: 其所卜筮，十中八九。

translations.literal: In his divination by tortoise shell and yarrow stalks, eight or nine of ten hit the mark.
translations.idiomatic: In his divination by tortoise shell and yarrow stalks, eight or nine of ten hit the mark.

sentences.zh: 別有林占，世或傳之。

translations.literal: He also had forest divination, sometimes transmitted in the world.
translations.idiomatic: He also had forest divination, sometimes transmitted in the world.

sentences.zh: 而性不和俗，時有王公欲求其筮者，玄則拒而不許，每云：「今既貴矣，更何所求而復卜也，欲望意外乎？

translations.literal: But his nature did not harmonize with the vulgar; when kings and nobles wished to seek his divination, Xuan refused and would not consent, always saying, "Now that you are already noble, what more do you seek that you again divinate—do you desire the unexpected?"
translations.idiomatic: But his nature did not harmonize with the vulgar; when kings and nobles wished to seek his divination, Xuan refused and would not consent, always saying, "Now that you are already noble, what more do you seek that you again divinate—do you desire the unexpected?"

sentences.zh: 」代京法禁嚴切，王公聞之，莫不驚悚而退。

translations.literal: In the capital of Dai the laws were strict; kings and nobles hearing this were all startled and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the capital of Dai the laws were strict; kings and nobles hearing this were all startled and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 故玄多見憎忿，不為貴勝所親。

translations.literal: Thus Xuan was much hated and resented, not favored by the noble and victorious.
translations.idiomatic: Thus Xuan was much hated and resented, not favored by the noble and victorious.

sentences.zh: 官至鉅鹿太守。

translations.literal: He reached the post of Administrator of Julu.
translations.idiomatic: He reached the post of Administrator of Julu.

sentences.zh: 顯祖、高祖時有勃海高道埏、清河趙法逞並有名於世。

translations.literal: Under Emperors Xianzu and Gaozu there were Gao Daodi of Bohai and Zhao Facheng of Qinghe, both famous in the world.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperors Xianzu and Gaozu there were Gao Daodi of Bohai and Zhao Facheng of Qinghe, both famous in the world.

sentences.zh: 世宗、肅宗時奉車都尉清河魏道虔、奉車都尉周恃、魏郡太守章武高月光、月光弟明月、任玄智、雍州人潘捺，並長於陰陽卜筮。

translations.literal: Under Emperors Shizong and Suzong, Chief of the Imperial Carriage Wei Daoxian of Qinghe, Chief of the Imperial Carriage Zhou Shi, Administrator of Wei Commandery Gao Yueguang of Zhangwu, Yueguang's younger brother Mingyue, Ren Xuanzhi, and Pan Na of Yongzhou—all excelled in yin-yang divination.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperors Shizong and Suzong, Chief of the Imperial Carriage Wei Daoxian of Qinghe, Chief of the Imperial Carriage Zhou Shi, Administrator of Wei Commandery Gao Yueguang of Zhangwu, Yueguang's younger brother Mingyue, Ren Xuanzhi, and Pan Na of Yongzhou—all excelled in yin-yang divination.

sentences.zh: 故玄於日者之中最為優洽。

translations.literal: Thus among diviners Xuan was the most congenial.
translations.idiomatic: Thus among diviners Xuan was the most congenial.

sentences.zh: 冠軍將軍、濮陽賈元紹、章武呂肫、濟北馮道安、河內馮懷、海東郡李文殊並工於法術，而道虔、月光、文殊為優，其餘不及。

translations.literal: Champion General Jia Yuanshao of Puyang, Lü Chun of Zhangwu, Feng Dao'an of Jibei, Feng Huai of Henei, and Li Wenshu of Hai'dong Commandery were all skilled in arts; among them Daoxian, Yueguang, and Wenshu were superior—the rest did not match.
translations.idiomatic: Champion General Jia Yuanshao of Puyang, Lü Chun of Zhangwu, Feng Dao'an of Jibei, Feng Huai of Henei, and Li Wenshu of Hai'dong Commandery were all skilled in arts; among them Daoxian, Yueguang, and Wenshu were superior—the rest did not match.

sentences.zh: 浮陽孟剛、饒安王領郡善銓錄風角，章武顏惡頭善卜筮，亦用耿玄林占，當時最知名。

translations.literal: Meng Gang of Fuyang and Wang Lingjun of Rao'an were skilled at recording wind angles; Yan Etou of Zhangwu was skilled at divination—they also used Geng Xuan's forest divination and were most renowned at the time.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Gang of Fuyang and Wang Lingjun of Rao'an were skilled at recording wind angles; Yan Etou of Zhangwu was skilled at divination—they also used Geng Xuan's forest divination and were most renowned at the time.

sentences.zh: 范陽人劉弁亦有名於世。

translations.literal: Liu Bian of Fanyang was also famous in the world.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Bian of Fanyang was also famous in the world.

sentences.zh: 劉靈助，燕郡人。

translations.literal: Liu Lingzhu was a man of Yan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Lingzhu was a man of Yan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 師事劉弁，好陰陽占卜，而粗疏無賴，常去來燕恒之界，或時負販，或復劫盜，賣術於巿。

translations.literal: He studied under Liu Bian, fond of yin-yang divination but coarse and unrestrained; he often traveled the border of Yan and Heng, sometimes peddling, sometimes robbing, selling arts in the market.
translations.idiomatic: He studied under Liu Bian, fond of yin-yang divination but coarse and unrestrained; he often traveled the border of Yan and Heng, sometimes peddling, sometimes robbing, selling arts in the market.

sentences.zh: 後自代至秀容，因事尒朱榮。

translations.literal: Later from Dai he came to Xiurong and entered the service of Erzhu Rong.
translations.idiomatic: Later from Dai he came to Xiurong and entered the service of Erzhu Rong.

sentences.zh: 榮性信卜筮，靈助所占屢中，遂被親待，為榮府功曹參軍。

translations.literal: Rong trusted divination; Lingzhu's prognostications often hit the mark and he was treated with intimacy, serving as Staff Officer of Rong's headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Rong trusted divination; Lingzhu's prognostications often hit the mark and he was treated with intimacy, serving as Staff Officer of Rong's headquarters.

sentences.zh: 建義初，榮於河陰王公卿士悉見屠害。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianyi, Rong at Heyin slaughtered all the kings, dukes, and ministers.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jianyi, Rong at Heyin slaughtered all the kings, dukes, and ministers.

sentences.zh: 時奉車都尉盧道虔兄弟亦相率朝於行宮，靈助以其州里，衞護之，由是朝士與諸盧相隨免害者數十人。

translations.literal: Chief of the Imperial Carriage Lu Daoxian and his brothers also came in succession to the mobile palace; Lingzhu, as their countryman, protected them, and thus several tens of court officials escaped harm together with the Lu clan.
translations.idiomatic: Chief of the Imperial Carriage Lu Daoxian and his brothers also came in succession to the mobile palace; Lingzhu, as their countryman, protected them, and thus several tens of court officials escaped harm together with the Lu clan.

sentences.zh: 榮入京師，超拜光祿大夫，封長子縣開國伯，食邑七百戶，尋進爵為公，增邑通前千戶。

translations.literal: When Rong entered the capital, Lingzhu was specially promoted to Director of the Imperial Secretariat, enfeoffed as Baron of Changzi with a fief of seven hundred households; soon his title was advanced to duke with a combined fief of one thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: When Rong entered the capital, Lingzhu was specially promoted to Director of the Imperial Secretariat, enfeoffed as Baron of Changzi with a fief of seven hundred households; soon his title was advanced to duke with a combined fief of one thousand households.

sentences.zh: 後從榮討擒葛榮，特除散騎常侍、撫軍將軍、幽州刺史。

translations.literal: Later following Rong he captured Ge Rong and was specially appointed Regular Palace Attendant, General Who Pacifies the Army, and Governor of Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Later following Rong he captured Ge Rong and was specially appointed Regular Palace Attendant, General Who Pacifies the Army, and Governor of Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 又從大將軍、上黨王天穆討邢杲。

translations.literal: He also followed Grand General Prince of Shangdang Tian Mu against Xing Gao.
translations.idiomatic: He also followed Grand General Prince of Shangdang Tian Mu against Xing Gao.

sentences.zh: 時幽州流民盧城人最為兇捍，遂令靈助兼尚書，軍前慰勞之。

translations.literal: At that time the displaced people of Lucheng in Youzhou were the most fierce; Lingzhu was ordered to act as Acting Master of Writing to comfort them before the army.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the displaced people of Lucheng in Youzhou were the most fierce; Lingzhu was ordered to act as Acting Master of Writing to comfort them before the army.

sentences.zh: 事平而元顥入洛，天穆渡河。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled Yuan Hao entered Luoyang and Tian Mu crossed the river.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was settled Yuan Hao entered Luoyang and Tian Mu crossed the river.

sentences.zh: 靈助先會尒朱榮於太行。

translations.literal: Lingzhu first met Erzhu Rong at Taihang.
translations.idiomatic: Lingzhu first met Erzhu Rong at Taihang.

sentences.zh: 及將攻河內，令靈助筮之。

translations.literal: When about to attack Henei, Rong had Lingzhu divinate.
translations.idiomatic: When about to attack Henei, Rong had Lingzhu divinate.

sentences.zh: 靈助曰：「未時必克。

translations.literal: Lingzhu said, "It will surely be taken at the wei hour."
translations.idiomatic: Lingzhu said, "It will surely be taken at the wei hour."

sentences.zh: 」時已向中，士眾疲怠，靈助曰：「時至矣。

translations.literal: The time was already past midday and the troops were weary; Lingzhu said, "The hour has come."
translations.idiomatic: The time was already past midday and the troops were weary; Lingzhu said, "The hour has come."

sentences.zh: 」榮鼓之，將士騰躍，即便克陷。

translations.literal: Rong beat the drums; officers and soldiers leaped forward and immediately captured it.
translations.idiomatic: Rong beat the drums; officers and soldiers leaped forward and immediately captured it.

sentences.zh: 及至北中，榮攻城不獲，以時盛暑，議欲且還，以待秋涼。

translations.literal: When they reached Beizhong, Rong could not take the city; as it was the height of summer, they discussed returning for a while to wait for autumn cool.
translations.idiomatic: When they reached Beizhong, Rong could not take the city; as it was the height of summer, they discussed returning for a while to wait for autumn cool.

sentences.zh: 莊帝詔靈助筮之。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhuang ordered Lingzhu to divinate.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhuang ordered Lingzhu to divinate.

sentences.zh: 靈助曰：「必當破賊。

translations.literal: Lingzhu said, "The rebels will surely be broken."
translations.idiomatic: Lingzhu said, "The rebels will surely be broken."

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「何日？

translations.literal: The edict asked, "What day?"
translations.idiomatic: The edict asked, "What day?"

sentences.zh: 」靈助曰：「十八、十九間。

translations.literal: Lingzhu said, "Between the eighteenth and nineteenth."
translations.idiomatic: Lingzhu said, "Between the eighteenth and nineteenth."

sentences.zh: 」果如其言。

translations.literal: It happened exactly as he said.
translations.idiomatic: It happened exactly as he said.

sentences.zh: 車駕還宮，領幽州大中正，尋加征東將軍，增邑五百戶，進爵為燕郡公，詔贈其父僧安為幽州刺史。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage returned to the palace, he headed the Great Rectifier of Youzhou; soon he was additionally appointed General Who Conquers the East with five hundred added households and advanced to Duke of Yan Commandery; an edict posthumously appointed his father Seng'an Governor of Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage returned to the palace, he headed the Great Rectifier of Youzhou; soon he was additionally appointed General Who Conquers the East with five hundred added households and advanced to Duke of Yan Commandery; an edict posthumously appointed his father Seng'an Governor of Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 尋兼尚書左僕射，慰勞幽州流民於濮陽、頓丘，因率民北還。

translations.literal: Soon he also served as Acting Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, comforting displaced people of Youzhou at Puyang and Dunqiu, and leading the people north.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he also served as Acting Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, comforting displaced people of Youzhou at Puyang and Dunqiu, and leading the people north.

sentences.zh: 與都督侯淵等討葛榮餘黨韓婁，滅之於薊。

translations.literal: Together with Commander Hou Yuan and others he attacked Han Lou, remnant of Ge Rong, and destroyed him at Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Commander Hou Yuan and others he attacked Han Lou, remnant of Ge Rong, and destroyed him at Ji.

sentences.zh: 仍釐州務，加車騎將軍，又為幽、平、營、安四州行臺。

translations.literal: He then put provincial affairs in order, was additionally appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry, and also served as Mobile Headquarters for You, Ping, Ying, and An provinces.
translations.idiomatic: He then put provincial affairs in order, was additionally appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry, and also served as Mobile Headquarters for You, Ping, Ying, and An provinces.

sentences.zh: 及尒朱榮死，莊帝幽崩。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Rong died, Emperor Zhuang was secretly killed.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Rong died, Emperor Zhuang was secretly killed.

sentences.zh: 靈助本寒微，一朝至此，自謂方術堪能動眾。

translations.literal: Lingzhu was originally of humble origin; reaching this position in one morning, he believed his arts could move the masses.
translations.idiomatic: Lingzhu was originally of humble origin; reaching this position in one morning, he believed his arts could move the masses.

sentences.zh: 又以尒朱有誅滅之兆，靈助遂自號燕王、車騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、大行臺，為莊帝舉義兵。

translations.literal: Also seeing signs of Erzhu's destruction, Lingzhu then styled himself King of Yan, Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Director with credentials equal to the Three Excellencies, and Grand Mobile Headquarters, raising righteous troops for Emperor Zhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Also seeing signs of Erzhu's destruction, Lingzhu then styled himself King of Yan, Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Director with credentials equal to the Three Excellencies, and Grand Mobile Headquarters, raising righteous troops for Emperor Zhuang.

sentences.zh: 靈助馴養大鳥，稱為己瑞，妄說圖讖，言劉氏當王，又云「欲知避世入鳥村」。

translations.literal: Lingzhu trained a great bird, calling it his auspicious sign; he falsely spoke of charts and prophecies, saying the Liu clan would become kings, and also said, "If you wish to know how to escape the world, enter Bird Village."
translations.idiomatic: Lingzhu trained a great bird, calling it his auspicious sign; he falsely spoke of charts and prophecies, saying the Liu clan would become kings, and also said, "If you wish to know how to escape the world, enter Bird Village."

sentences.zh: 遂刻氈為人象，畫桃木為符書，作詭道厭祝之法。

translations.literal: He then carved felt into human figures, painted peachwood talisman texts, and made methods of sorcery and exorcistic prayer.
translations.idiomatic: He then carved felt into human figures, painted talisman texts on peachwood, and devised sorcery and exorcistic rites.

sentences.zh: 民多信之。

translations.literal: The people widely believed in him.
translations.idiomatic: Many among the people believed in him.

sentences.zh: 於時河西人紇豆陵步藩舉兵逼晉陽，尒朱兆頻戰不利，故靈助唱言：「尒朱自然當滅，不須我兵。

translations.literal: At that time Hedong native Gedouling Bufan raised troops and pressed on Jinyang; Erzhu Zhao repeatedly fought without success, so Lingzhu proclaimed, "The Erzhu will naturally perish—I need no troops of my own.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Bufan of the Gedouling clan in Hedong raised troops against Jinyang; Erzhu Zhao fought repeatedly without success, so Lingzhu declared, "The Erzhu will perish of themselves—I need no army of my own.

sentences.zh: 」由是幽、瀛、滄、冀之民悉從之。

translations.literal: " Thereupon the people of You, Ying, Cang, and Ji all followed him.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the people of You, Ying, Cang, and Ji provinces all rallied to him.

sentences.zh: 從之者夜悉舉火為號，不舉火者諸村共屠之。

translations.literal: Followers at night all raised fires as signals; those who did not raise fire were jointly slaughtered by the villages.
translations.idiomatic: Followers lit fires at night as signals; any village that failed to do so was jointly put to the sword.

sentences.zh: 以普泰元年三月，率眾至博陵之安國城，與叱列延慶、侯淵、尒朱羽生等戰，戰敗被擒，斬於定州，傳首洛陽，支分其體。

translations.literal: In the third month of the Putai era, first year, he led his host to Anguo city in Boling and fought Chilie Yanqing, Hou Yuan, Erzhu Yusheng, and others; defeated and captured, he was beheaded at Dingzhou, his head sent to Luoyang, and his body dismembered.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Putai 1, he led his forces to Anguo city in Boling and fought Chilie Yanqing, Hou Yuan, Erzhu Yusheng, and others. Defeated and captured, he was executed at Dingzhou; his head was sent to Luoyang and his body dismembered.

sentences.zh: 初，靈助每云：「三月末，我必入定州，尒朱亦必滅。

translations.literal: Earlier Lingzhu had often said, "At the end of the third month I shall surely enter Dingzhou, and the Erzhu will also surely perish.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Lingzhu had often said, "At the end of the third month I shall surely enter Dingzhou, and the Erzhu will also surely perish.

sentences.zh: 」及將戰，靈助自筮之，卦成不吉，以手折蓍，棄之於地，云「此何知也」。

translations.literal: " When about to fight, Lingzhu divined for himself; the hexagram formed was inauspicious—he broke the yarrow stalks with his hand, threw them to the ground, and said, "What does this know?"
translations.idiomatic: " When battle was near, Lingzhu divined for himself; the hexagram was inauspicious. He snapped the yarrow stalks, threw them to the ground, and said, "What does this know?"

sentences.zh: 尋見擒，果以三月入定州，而齊獻武王以明年閏二月破四胡於韓陵山，[8]遂滅兆等。

translations.literal: Soon he was captured; indeed in the third month he entered Dingzhou, while Prince Xianwu of Qi in the intercalary second month of the following year broke the Four Hu at Hanling Mountain, [8] and thus destroyed Zhao and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon captured; indeed he entered Dingzhou in the third month, while Prince Xianwu of Qi in the intercalary second month of the following year defeated the Four Hu at Hanling Mountain, [8] and destroyed Zhao and his allies.

sentences.zh: 永熙二年，贈使持節、散騎常侍、都督幽瀛冀三州諸軍事、驃騎大將軍、尚書左僕射、開府儀同三司、幽州刺史，諡曰恭。

translations.literal: In Yongxi 2 he was posthumously granted Bearer of the Staff, Regular Palace Attendant, Area Commander-in-Chief of the Military Affairs of You, Ying, and Ji provinces, General of Agile Cavalry, Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, Director with credentials equal to the Three Excellencies, and Governor of Youzhou, with posthumous title Gong.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongxi 2 he was posthumously granted Bearer of the Staff, Regular Palace Attendant, Area Commander-in-Chief for You, Ying, and Ji, General of Agile Cavalry, Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, Director with credentials equal to the Three Excellencies, and Governor of Youzhou, with posthumous title Gong.

sentences.zh: 子宗輝，襲。

translations.literal: His son Zonghui succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zonghui succeeded to the title.

sentences.zh: 興和中開府，屬齊受禪，例降。

translations.literal: In Xinghe he opened a directorate; when Qi received the abdication, he was demoted by precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xinghe era he held an open directorate; when Qi received the abdication, he was demoted according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 江式，字法安，陳留濟陽人。

translations.literal: Jiang Shi, courtesy name Fa'an, was a man of Jiyang in Chenliu.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Shi, courtesy name Fa'an, was a native of Jiyang in Chenliu.

sentences.zh: 六世祖瓊，字孟琚，晉馮翊太守，善蟲篆、詁訓。

translations.literal: His sixth-generation ancestor Qiong, courtesy name Mengju, was Administrator of Fufeng in Jin and excelled at seal script and glossarial exegesis.
translations.idiomatic: His sixth-generation ancestor Qiong, courtesy name Mengju, was Jin Administrator of Fufeng and excelled at seal script and glossarial exegesis.

sentences.zh: 永嘉大亂，瓊棄官西投張軌，子孫因居涼土，世傳家業。

translations.literal: In the great chaos of the Yongjia era, Qiong abandoned office and went west to join Zhang Gui; descendants thus settled in Liang territory and transmitted the family profession for generations.
translations.idiomatic: During the great chaos of the Yongjia era, Qiong resigned his post and went west to Zhang Gui; his descendants settled in Liang territory and passed down the family profession for generations.

sentences.zh: 祖彊，字文威，太延五年，涼州平，內徙代京。

translations.literal: His grandfather Qiang, courtesy name Wenwei, in Taiyan 5 when Liangzhou was pacified was moved inward to the capital of Dai.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Qiang, courtesy name Wenwei, was relocated to the capital of Dai in Taiyan 5 when Liangzhou was pacified.

sentences.zh: 上書三十餘法，各有體例，又獻經史諸子千餘卷，由是擢拜中書博士。

translations.literal: He submitted more than thirty methods in writing, each with its own categories; he also presented over a thousand scrolls of classics, histories, and masters, and for this was promoted to Erudite of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted more than thirty written methods, each with its own categories, and also presented over a thousand scrolls of classics, histories, and masters' works; for this he was promoted to Erudite of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈敦煌太守。

translations.literal: On death he was posthumously granted Administrator of Dunhuang.
translations.idiomatic: On his death he was posthumously granted the title Administrator of Dunhuang.

sentences.zh: 父紹興，高允奏為祕書郎，掌國史二十餘年，以謹厚稱。

translations.literal: His father Shaoxing, recommended by Gao Yun as Secretary, managed the national history for more than twenty years and was known for prudence and steadiness.
translations.idiomatic: His father Shaoxing, recommended by Gao Yun as Secretary, managed the national history for more than twenty years and was known for prudence and steadiness.

sentences.zh: 卒於趙郡太守。

translations.literal: He died while Administrator of Zhao commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He died while serving as Administrator of Zhao commandery.

sentences.zh: 式少專家學。

translations.literal: Shi from youth devoted himself to the family learning.
translations.idiomatic: From youth Shi devoted himself to the family learning.

sentences.zh: 數年之中，常夢兩人時相教授，乃寤，每有記識。

translations.literal: Within several years he often dreamed of two men teaching each other; on waking he always had things to record.
translations.idiomatic: Over several years he often dreamed of two men instructing each other; on waking he always had something to record.

sentences.zh: 初拜司徒長兼行參軍、檢校御史，尋除殄寇將軍、符節令。

translations.literal: He was first appointed Adjunct Acting Staff Officer to the Minister of Education and Investigating Censor; soon after he was removed to General Who Slays Bandits and Director of Tallies and Credentials.
translations.idiomatic: He was first appointed Adjunct Acting Staff Officer to the Minister of Education and Investigating Censor; soon after he was appointed General Who Slays Bandits and Director of Tallies and Credentials.

sentences.zh: 以書文昭太后尊號諡冊，特除奉朝請，仍符節令。

translations.literal: For writing the honorific title and posthumous edict of Empress Dowager Wen, he was specially appointed Attendant at Court and still held the post of Director of Tallies and Credentials.
translations.idiomatic: For writing the honorific title and posthumous edict of Empress Dowager Wen, he was specially appointed Attendant at Court while retaining the post of Director of Tallies and Credentials.

sentences.zh: 式篆體尤工，洛京宮殿諸門板題，皆式書也。

translations.literal: Shi was especially skilled at seal script; the gate plaques of the palaces of Luoyang were all written by Shi.
translations.idiomatic: Shi was especially skilled at seal script; the gate plaques of Luoyang's palaces were all written by him.

sentences.zh: 延昌三年三月，式上表曰：

translations.literal: In the third month of Yanchang 3, Shi submitted a memorial saying:
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Yanchang 3, Shi submitted a memorial saying:

sentences.zh: 臣聞庖羲氏作而八卦列其畫，軒轅氏興而龜策彰其彩。

translations.literal: Your servant has heard that when Fuxi arose the eight trigrams displayed their lines, and when the Yellow Emperor arose tortoise and yarrow revealed their colors.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant has heard that when Fuxi arose the eight trigrams displayed their lines, and when the Yellow Emperor arose tortoise shells and yarrow stalks revealed their patterns.

sentences.zh: 古史倉頡覽二象之爻，觀鳥獸之跡，別創文字，以代結繩，用書契以維事。

translations.literal: The ancient scribe Cangjie contemplated the lines of the two images, observed the tracks of birds and beasts, and separately created writing to replace knotted cords, using written contracts to maintain affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The ancient scribe Cangjie contemplated the lines of the two images, observed the tracks of birds and beasts, and created writing to replace knotted cords, using written contracts to govern affairs.

sentences.zh: 宣之王庭，則百工以敍；

translations.literal: In the royal court of Xuan, then the hundred crafts were ordered;
translations.idiomatic: In the royal court of King Xuan, the hundred crafts were ordered;

sentences.zh: 載之方冊，則萬品以明。

translations.literal: Recorded in the registers, then the myriad things were clarified.
translations.idiomatic: recorded in the registers, the myriad things were clarified.

sentences.zh: 迄于三代，厥體頗異，雖依類取制，未能悉殊倉氏矣。

translations.literal: Down to the Three Dynasties their forms differed considerably; though taking models by category, they could not entirely differ from Cangjie's system.
translations.idiomatic: Down to the Three Dynasties their forms differed considerably; though models were taken by category, they could not entirely depart from Cangjie's system.

sentences.zh: 故周禮八歲入小學，保氏教國子以六書：一曰指事，二曰象形，三曰諧聲，四曰會意，五曰轉注，六曰假借。

translations.literal: Thus the Rites of Zhou: at eight years one enters the primary school; the tutor teaches the sons of the state the six scripts—first indicative, second pictographic, third phonetic, fourth ideographic, fifth derivative gloss, sixth loan.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the Rites of Zhou: at eight years one enters primary school, and the tutor teaches the sons of the state the six scripts—first indicative, second pictographic, third phonetic, fourth ideographic, fifth derivative gloss, and sixth loan.

sentences.zh: 蓋是史頡之遺法也。

translations.literal: This was roughly the transmitted method of Scribe Cang.
translations.idiomatic: This was roughly the transmitted method of Scribe Cang.

sentences.zh: 及宣王太史史籀著大篆十五篇，與古文或同或異，時人即謂之「籕書」。

translations.literal: When King Xuan's Grand Scribe Shizhou composed fifteen chapters in great seal script, they were sometimes the same as and sometimes different from ancient script; people of the time called this "Zhou script."
translations.idiomatic: When King Xuan's Grand Scribe Shizhou composed fifteen chapters in great seal script, they sometimes matched and sometimes differed from ancient script; people of the time called this "Zhou script."

sentences.zh: 至孔子定六經，左丘明述春秋，皆以古文，厥意可得而言。

translations.literal: When Confucius fixed the Six Classics and Zuo Qiuming narrated the Spring and Autumn, all used ancient script—their intent can be spoken of.
translations.idiomatic: When Confucius fixed the Six Classics and Zuo Qiuming narrated the Spring and Autumn, all used ancient script—their intent can be understood.

sentences.zh: 其後七國殊軌，文字乖別，暨秦兼天下，丞相李斯乃奏蠲罷不合秦文者。

translations.literal: Afterward the seven states had separate tracks and writing diverged; when Qin united the realm, Chancellor Li Si memorialized to abolish what did not accord with Qin script.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward the seven states followed separate paths and writing diverged; when Qin united the realm, Chancellor Li Si memorialized to abolish forms that did not accord with Qin script.

sentences.zh: 斯作倉頡篇，中車府令趙高作爰歷篇，太史令胡母敬作博學篇，皆取史籀大篆，或頗省改，所謂小篆者也。
