translations.literal: Si composed the Cangjie primer; Director of the Central Chariot Office Zhao Gao composed the Aili primer; Grand Scribe Humu Jing composed the Boxue primer—all took Shizhou's great seal, with some simplification and alteration, what is called small seal script.
translations.idiomatic: Si composed the Cangjie primer; Director of the Central Chariot Office Zhao Gao composed the Aili primer; Grand Scribe Humu Jing composed the Boxue primer—all drew on Shizhou's great seal with some simplification and alteration, what is called small seal script.

sentences.zh: 於是秦燒經書、滌除舊典，官獄繁多，以趣約易，始用隸書。

translations.literal: Thereupon Qin burned the classics and washed away old canons; official prisons multiplied, and to pursue brevity and ease, clerical script began to be used.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Qin burned the classics and washed away old canons; official prisons multiplied, and to pursue brevity and ease, clerical script began to be used.

sentences.zh: 古文由此息矣。

translations.literal: Ancient script thus ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient script thus fell out of use.

sentences.zh: 隸書者，始皇使下杜人程邈附於小篆所作也，以邈徒隸，即謂之隸書。

translations.literal: Clerical script: the First Emperor had Xiadu native Cheng Miao attach it to small seal script; because Miao was a convict laborer (li), it was called clerical script.
translations.idiomatic: Clerical script: the First Emperor had Xiadu native Cheng Miao derive it from small seal script; because Miao was a convict laborer (li), it was called clerical script.

sentences.zh: 故秦有八體：一曰大篆，二曰小篆，三曰刻符書，四曰蟲書，五曰摹印，六曰署書，七曰殳書，八曰隸書。

translations.literal: Thus Qin had eight scripts: first great seal, second small seal, third tally script, fourth worm script, fifth seal impression, sixth signature script, seventh weapon script, eighth clerical script.
translations.idiomatic: Thus Qin had eight scripts: first great seal, second small seal, third tally script, fourth worm script, fifth seal impression, sixth signature script, seventh weapon script, and eighth clerical script.

sentences.zh: 漢興，有尉律學，復教以籕書，又習八體，試之課最，以為尚書史。

translations.literal: When Han arose there was the Commandant's Law School, again teaching Zhou script and also practicing the eight scripts; tested and ranked highest, one became a Secretariat clerk.
translations.idiomatic: When Han arose there was the Commandant's Law School, again teaching Zhou script and practicing the eight scripts; those who tested highest became Secretariat clerks.

sentences.zh: 吏民上書，省字不正，輒舉劾焉。

translations.literal: When officials and commoners submitted documents, if characters were incorrect they were impeached.
translations.idiomatic: When officials and commoners submitted documents, incorrect characters led to impeachment.

sentences.zh: 又有草書，莫知誰始，考其書形，雖無厥誼，亦是一時之變通也。

translations.literal: There was also cursive script; who began it is unknown—examining its written form, though without fixed meaning, it was also a temporary adaptation of the time.
translations.idiomatic: There was also cursive script; who began it is unknown—examining its written form, though without fixed rules, it was also a temporary adaptation of the age.

sentences.zh: 孝宣時，召通倉頡讀者，獨張敞從之受。

translations.literal: In the time of Emperor Xuan, those who could read Cangjie were summoned; only Zhang Chang received instruction.
translations.idiomatic: In the time of Emperor Xuan, those who could read Cangjie were summoned; only Zhang Chang received instruction.

sentences.zh: 涼州刺史杜鄴、沛人爰禮、講學大夫秦近亦能言之。

translations.literal: Inspector of Liangzhou Du Ye, Pei native Yuan Li, and Erudite Qin Jin could also speak of it.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Liangzhou Du Ye, Pei native Yuan Li, and Erudite Qin Jin could also speak of it.

sentences.zh: 孝平時，徵禮等百餘人說文字於未央宮中，以禮為小學元士。

translations.literal: In Emperor Ping's time, Li and more than a hundred others were summoned to explain writing in Weiyang Palace; Li was made Chief Erudite of the Primary School.
translations.idiomatic: In Emperor Ping's time, Li and more than a hundred others were summoned to explain writing in Weiyang Palace; Li was made Chief Erudite of the Primary School.

sentences.zh: 黃門侍郎揚雄採以作訓纂篇。

translations.literal: Yellow Gate Gentleman Yang Xiong gathered this to compose the Xunzuan primer.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow Gate Gentleman Yang Xiong gathered this material to compose the Xunzuan primer.

sentences.zh: 及亡新居攝，自以應運制作，使大司空甄豐校文字之部，頗改定古文。

translations.literal: When Wang Mang held the regency, deeming himself to respond to the age in making institutions, he had Grand Minister Zhen Feng collate the section on writing and considerably revised ancient script.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Mang held the regency, deeming himself destined to make institutions for the age, he had Grand Minister Zhen Feng collate the section on writing and considerably revised ancient script.

sentences.zh: 時有六書：一曰古文，孔子壁中書也；

translations.literal: At the time there were six scripts: first ancient script, the books from Confucius's wall;
translations.idiomatic: At the time there were six scripts: first ancient script, the books from Confucius's wall;

sentences.zh: 二曰奇字，即古文而異者；

translations.literal: second odd characters, that is ancient script with differences;
translations.idiomatic: second odd characters, that is ancient script with variant forms;

sentences.zh: 三曰篆書，云小篆也；

translations.literal: third seal script, meaning small seal;
translations.idiomatic: third seal script, meaning small seal;

sentences.zh: 四曰佐書，秦隸書也；

translations.literal: fourth assistant script, Qin clerical script;
translations.idiomatic: fourth assistant script, Qin clerical script;

sentences.zh: 五曰繆篆，所以摹印也；

translations.literal: fifth twisted seal, used for seal impressions;
translations.idiomatic: fifth twisted seal, used for seal impressions;

sentences.zh: 六曰鳥蟲，所以幡信也。

translations.literal: sixth bird-and-worm, used for banners and credentials.
translations.idiomatic: sixth bird-and-worm, used for banners and credentials.

sentences.zh: 壁中書者，魯恭王壞孔子宅而得禮、尚書、春秋、論語、孝經也。

translations.literal: The wall books: when King Gong of Lu destroyed Confucius's house he obtained the Rites, Documents, Spring and Autumn, Analects, and Classic of Filial Piety.
translations.idiomatic: The wall books: when King Gong of Lu destroyed Confucius's house he obtained the Rites, Documents, Spring and Autumn, Analects, and Classic of Filial Piety.

sentences.zh: 又北平侯張倉獻春秋左氏傳，書體與孔氏相類，即前代之古文矣。

translations.literal: Also Marquis Cang of Beiping presented the Zuo Tradition of the Spring and Autumn; its script resembled that of the Kong clan—the ancient script of former ages.
translations.idiomatic: Also Marquis Cang of Beiping presented the Zuo Tradition of the Spring and Autumn; its script resembled that of the Kong clan—the ancient script of former ages.

sentences.zh: 後漢郎中扶風曹喜號曰工篆，小異斯法，而甚精巧，自是後學皆其法也。

translations.literal: Later Han Gentleman Cao Xi of Fufeng was called skilled at seal script; slightly differing from Si's method yet very refined, from then on later students all followed his method.
translations.idiomatic: Later Han Gentleman Cao Xi of Fufeng was called skilled at seal script; slightly differing from Si's method yet very refined, and from then on later students all followed his method.

sentences.zh: 又詔侍中賈逵修理舊文。

translations.literal: Also an edict ordered Attendant-in-Ordinary Jia Kui to repair old texts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also ordered Attendant-in-Ordinary Jia Kui to repair old texts.

sentences.zh: 殊藝異術，王教一端，苟有可以加於國者，靡不悉集。

translations.literal: Special arts and unusual techniques, one strand of royal teaching—if anything could benefit the state, none was not fully gathered.
translations.idiomatic: Special arts and unusual techniques are one strand of royal teaching—if anything could benefit the state, none was not fully gathered.

sentences.zh: 逵即汝南許慎古文學之師也。

translations.literal: Kui was the teacher of Xu Shen of Runan in ancient-script learning.
translations.idiomatic: Kui was the teacher of Xu Shen of Runan in ancient-script learning.

sentences.zh: 後慎嗟時人之好奇，歎儒俗之穿鑿，惋文毀於譽，痛字敗於訾，更詭任情，變亂於世，故撰說文解字十五篇，首一終亥，各有部屬，包括六藝羣書之詁，評釋百氏諸子之訓，天地、山川、草木、鳥獸、昆蟲、雜物、奇怪珍異、王制禮儀、世間人事莫不畢載。

translations.literal: Later Shen lamented people's curiosity of the time, sighed at vulgar Confucian pedantry, grieved that texts were ruined by praise and characters spoiled by censure, that capricious distortion ran wild in the world; therefore he composed Explaining Graphs and Analyzing Characters in fifteen chapters, from yi to hai, each with its own category, including glosses of the Six Arts and all books, evaluating and explaining the glosses of the hundred schools, heaven and earth, mountains and rivers, plants and trees, birds and beasts, insects, miscellaneous things, strange and rare objects, royal institutions and ritual propriety, and human affairs of the world—nothing not fully recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Later Shen lamented the curiosity of his age, sighed at vulgar Confucian pedantry, grieved that texts were ruined by praise and characters spoiled by censure, that capricious distortion ran wild in the world; therefore he composed Explaining Graphs and Analyzing Characters in fifteen chapters, from yi to hai, each with its own category, including glosses of the Six Arts and all books, evaluating the glosses of the hundred schools—heaven and earth, mountains and rivers, plants and trees, birds and beasts, insects, miscellaneous things, strange and rare objects, royal institutions and ritual propriety, and human affairs of the world—nothing was omitted.

sentences.zh: 可謂類聚羣分，雜而不越，文質彬彬，最可得而論也。

translations.literal: It can be called gathering by category and dividing into groups, mixed yet not transgressive, refined in both substance and form—most fit for discussion.
translations.idiomatic: It can be called gathering by category and dividing into groups, mixed yet not transgressive, refined in both substance and form—most fit for discussion.

sentences.zh: 左中郎將陳留蔡邕採李斯、曹喜之法為古今雜形，詔於太學立石碑，刊載五經，題書楷法，多是邕書也。

translations.literal: Left Palace Gentleman Cai Yong of Chenliu took the methods of Li Si and Cao Xi to make ancient-and-modern mixed forms; an edict erected stone steles at the Imperial Academy, carving the Five Classics, inscribing them in standard script—mostly Yong's writing.
translations.idiomatic: Left Palace Gentleman Cai Yong of Chenliu took the methods of Li Si and Cao Xi to make ancient-and-modern mixed forms; an edict erected stone steles at the Imperial Academy, carving the Five Classics and inscribing them in standard script—mostly Yong's writing.

sentences.zh: 後開鴻都，書畫奇能莫不雲集，于時諸方獻篆無出邕者。

translations.literal: Later when Hongdu was opened, all marvels of calligraphy and painting gathered like clouds; at the time none of the seal scripts presented from all quarters surpassed Yong.
translations.idiomatic: Later when Hongdu was opened, all marvels of calligraphy and painting gathered like clouds; at the time none of the seal scripts presented from all quarters surpassed Yong.

sentences.zh: 魏初博士清河張揖著埤倉、廣雅、古今字詁，[9]究諸埤廣，綴拾遺漏，增長事類，抑亦於文為益者。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Wei, Erudite Zhang Yi of Qinghe composed Picao, Guangya, and Ancient-and-Modern Character Glosses, [9] investigating the broad lexicons, patching omissions, augmenting categories of things—it also benefited writing.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Wei, Erudite Zhang Yi of Qinghe composed Picao, Guangya, and Ancient-and-Modern Character Glosses, [9] investigating the broad lexicons, patching omissions, and augmenting categories of things—it also benefited writing.

sentences.zh: 然其字詁，方之許慎篇，古今體用，或得或失矣。

translations.literal: Yet his character glosses, compared with Xu Shen's work, in ancient and modern form and use sometimes hit and sometimes missed.
translations.idiomatic: Yet his character glosses, compared with Xu Shen's work, in ancient and modern form and use sometimes succeeded and sometimes failed.

sentences.zh: 陳留邯鄲淳亦與揖同時，博古開藝，[10]特善倉、雅，許氏字指，八體六書精究閑理，有名於揖，以書教諸皇子。

translations.literal: Handan Chun of Chenliu was also contemporary with Yi, broad in antiquity and opening arts, [10] especially skilled in Cang and Ya, Xu's character principles, the eight scripts and six writings—deeply versed in their principles, famous alongside Yi, teaching writing to the princes.
translations.idiomatic: Handan Chun of Chenliu was also contemporary with Yi, broad in antiquity and opening arts, [10] especially skilled in Cang and Ya, Xu's character principles, the eight scripts and six writings—deeply versed in their principles, famous alongside Yi, teaching writing to the princes.

sentences.zh: 又建三字石經於漢碑之西，其文蔚炳，三體復宣。

translations.literal: He also built the Three-Script Stone Classic west of the Han stele; its text was splendid and the three scripts again proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: He also built the Three-Script Stone Classic west of the Han stele; its text was splendid and the three scripts were again proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 校之說文，篆隸大同，而古字少異。

translations.literal: Compared with Shuowen, seal and clerical were largely the same, but ancient characters differed slightly.
translations.idiomatic: Compared with Shuowen, seal and clerical were largely the same, but ancient characters differed slightly.

sentences.zh: 又有京兆韋誕、河東衞覬二家，並號能篆。

translations.literal: Also the two families of Wei Dan of Jingzhao and Wei Kai of Hedong were both called skilled at seal script.
translations.idiomatic: Also the two families of Wei Dan of Jingzhao and Wei Kai of Hedong were both called skilled at seal script.

sentences.zh: 當時臺觀榜題、寶器之銘，悉是誕書，咸傳之子孫，世稱其妙。

translations.literal: At the time platform and pavilion placards and inscriptions on precious vessels were all Dan's writing; all passed to descendants, and the age called them marvelous.
translations.idiomatic: At the time platform and pavilion placards and inscriptions on precious vessels were all Dan's writing; all passed to descendants, and the age called them marvelous.

sentences.zh: 晉世義陽王典祠令任城呂忱表上字林六卷，尋其況趣，附託許慎說文，而案偶章句，隱別古籕奇惑之字，文得正隸，不差篆意也。

translations.literal: In Jin, Director of Sacrifices to the Righteous King Lü Chen of Rencheng submitted the Zilin in six scrolls; seeking its scope and intent, it attached itself to Xu Shen's Shuowen, yet arranged paired phrases, distinguishing ancient Zhou, odd, and variant characters—the text obtained correct clerical form without losing seal intent.
translations.idiomatic: In Jin, Director of Sacrifices to the Righteous King Lü Chen of Rencheng submitted the Zilin in six scrolls; seeking its scope and intent, it attached itself to Xu Shen's Shuowen, yet arranged paired phrases, distinguishing ancient Zhou, odd, and variant characters—the text obtained correct clerical form without losing seal intent.

sentences.zh: 忱弟靜別放故左校令李登聲類之法，作韻集五卷，宮商角徵羽各為一篇，而文字與兄便是魯衞，音讀楚、夏，時有不同。

translations.literal: Chen's younger brother Jing separately followed the method of Sound Categories of former Left Commandant Li Deng and composed the Rhyme Collection in five scrolls, palace, merchant, angle, zhi, and yu each one chapter; yet characters differed from his elder brother like Lu from Wei, and readings of Chu and Xia sometimes differed.
translations.idiomatic: Chen's younger brother Jing separately followed the Sound Categories method of former Left Commandant Li Deng and composed the Rhyme Collection in five scrolls, with palace, merchant, angle, zhi, and yu each one chapter; yet characters differed from his elder brother like Lu from Wei, and readings of Chu and Xia sometimes differed.

sentences.zh: 皇魏承百王之季，紹五運之緒，世易風移，文字改變，篆形謬錯，隸體失真。

translations.literal: Great Wei succeeding the end of the hundred kings, continuing the thread of the five cycles, the age changed and customs shifted, writing altered, seal forms erring, clerical bodies losing truth.
translations.idiomatic: Great Wei, succeeding the end of the hundred kings and continuing the thread of the five cycles, saw the age change and customs shift, writing alter, seal forms err, and clerical bodies lose truth.

sentences.zh: 俗學鄙習，復加虛巧，談辯之士，又以意說，炫惑於時，難以釐改。

translations.literal: Vulgar learning and base habits again added empty cleverness; disputatious scholars also spoke from opinion, dazzling and deluding the age—hard to rectify.
translations.idiomatic: Vulgar learning and base habits again added empty cleverness; disputatious scholars also spoke from opinion, dazzling and deluding the age—hard to rectify.

sentences.zh: 故傳曰，以眾非，非行正。

translations.literal: Thus the tradition says: when the many deny, the correct is denied.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the tradition says: when the many deny, the correct is denied.

sentences.zh: 信哉得之於斯情矣。

translations.literal: Truly one obtains this from the situation.
translations.idiomatic: Truly one obtains this from the situation.

sentences.zh: 乃曰追來為歸，巧言為辯，小兔為䨲，[11]神虫為蠶，如斯甚眾，皆不合孔氏古書、史籕大篆、許氏說文、石經三字也。

translations.literal: Thus they say "come back" for "return," "clever speech" for "eloquence," "small rabbit" for snow, [11] "spirit worm" for silkworm—such cases are extremely numerous, all not matching Kong clan ancient books, Shizhou great seal, Xu's Shuowen, and the three-script stone classic.
translations.idiomatic: Thus they say "come back" for "return," "clever speech" for "eloquence," "small rabbit" for snow, [11] "spirit worm" for silkworm—such cases are extremely numerous, all not matching Kong clan ancient books, Shizhou great seal, Xu's Shuowen, and the three-script stone classic.

sentences.zh: 凡所關古，莫不惆悵焉。

translations.literal: All matters touching antiquity—none without regret.
translations.idiomatic: All matters touching antiquity—none without regret.

sentences.zh: 嗟夫！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 文字者六藝之宗，王教之始，前人所以垂今，今人所以識古，故曰「本立而道生」。

translations.literal: Writing is the ancestor of the Six Arts, the beginning of royal teaching; former men thereby transmit to the present, present men thereby know antiquity—thus it is said, "When the root is established, the Way arises."
translations.idiomatic: Writing is the ancestor of the Six Arts and the beginning of royal teaching; former men thereby transmit to the present, present men thereby know antiquity—thus it is said, "When the root is established, the Way arises."

sentences.zh: 孔子曰：「必也正名乎。

translations.literal: Confucius said, "One must rectify names.
translations.idiomatic: Confucius said, "One must rectify names.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「述而不作。

translations.literal: " He also said, "I transmit but do not compose.
translations.idiomatic: " He also said, "I transmit but do not compose.

sentences.zh: 」書曰：「予欲觀古人之象。

translations.literal: " The Documents say, "I wish to observe the images of the ancients.
translations.idiomatic: " The Documents say, "I wish to observe the images of the ancients.

sentences.zh: 」皆言遵修舊史而不敢穿鑿也。

translations.literal: " All speak of following and repairing old records and not daring to pedantically invent.
translations.idiomatic: " All speak of following and repairing old records and not daring to pedantically invent.

sentences.zh: 臣六世祖瓊家世陳留，往晉之初，與從父兄應元俱受學於衞覬，古篆之法，倉、雅、方言、說文之誼，當時並收善譽。

translations.literal: Your servant's sixth-generation ancestor Qiong's family for generations was in Chenliu; at the beginning of Jin he and his father's elder brother's son Yingyuan both studied under Wei Kai—methods of ancient seal script, the meanings of Cang, Ya, Fangyan, and Shuowen—at the time both received good repute.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant's sixth-generation ancestor Qiong's family for generations was in Chenliu; at the beginning of Jin he and his father's elder brother's son Yingyuan both studied under Wei Kai—methods of ancient seal script, the meanings of Cang, Ya, Fangyan, and Shuowen—at the time both received good repute.

sentences.zh: 而祖官至太子洗馬，出為馮翊郡，值洛陽之亂，避地河西，數世傳習，斯業所以不墜也。

translations.literal: The ancestor reached the post of Palace Groom for the Heir Apparent, went out as Administrator of Fufeng commandery; encountering the chaos of Luoyang, he took refuge in Hexi; for generations the profession was transmitted—thus the craft did not fall.
translations.idiomatic: The ancestor reached the post of Palace Groom for the Heir Apparent and went out as Administrator of Fufeng commandery; encountering the chaos of Luoyang, he took refuge in Hexi; for generations the profession was transmitted—thus the craft did not fall.

sentences.zh: 世祖太延中皇威西被，牧犍內附，臣亡祖文威杖策歸國，奉獻五世傳掌之書，古篆八體之法，時蒙褒錄，敍列於儒林，官班文省，家號世業。

translations.literal: In Taiyan of Emperor Shizu imperial might reached west; Mujian submitted inward; your servant's deceased grandfather Wenwei, staff in hand, returned to the state, presenting the books transmitted through five generations and methods of the eight ancient scripts; at the time he received commendation and enrollment, listed among the Confucian scholars, with office rank in the literary bureau—the family called it a hereditary profession.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiyan of Emperor Shizu imperial might reached west; Mujian submitted inward; your servant's deceased grandfather Wenwei, staff in hand, returned to the state, presenting the books transmitted through five generations and methods of the eight ancient scripts; at the time he received commendation and enrollment among the Confucian scholars, with office rank in the literary bureau—the family called it a hereditary profession.

sentences.zh: 暨臣闇短，識學庸薄，漸漬家風，有忝無顯。

translations.literal: When it came to your servant's dimness and shortcoming, knowledge and learning mediocre and thin, gradually steeped in the family wind, having disgrace without distinction.
translations.idiomatic: When it came to your servant's dimness and shortcoming, knowledge and learning mediocre and thin, gradually steeped in the family tradition, having disgrace without distinction.

sentences.zh: 但逢時來，恩出願外，每承澤雲津，厠霑漏潤，驅馳文閣，參預史官，題篆宮禁，猥同上哲。

translations.literal: But encountering the time's favor, grace beyond my wish, each time receiving the cloud ford's bounty, moistened by dripping favor, galloping in the literary pavilion, participating as historiographer, inscribing seal script in the palace forbidden—I am unworthily with the upper sages.
translations.idiomatic: But encountering the time's favor, grace beyond my wish, each time receiving the cloud ford's bounty, moistened by dripping favor, galloping in the literary pavilion, participating as historiographer, inscribing seal script in the palace forbidden—I am unworthily ranked with the upper sages.

sentences.zh: 既竭愚短，欲罷不能，是以敢藉六世之資，奉遵祖考之訓，竊慕古人之軌，企踐儒門之轍，輒求撰集古來文字，以許慎說文為主，爰採孔氏尚書、五經音注、籕篇、爾雅、三倉、凡將、方言、通俗文、祖文宗、[12]埤倉、廣雅、古今字詁、三字石經、字林、韻集、諸賦文字有六書之誼者，皆以次類編聯，文無復重，糾為一部。

translations.literal: Having exhausted my foolish shortcoming, wishing to stop yet unable, therefore I dare borrow the resources of six generations, respectfully follow my ancestors' instruction, privately admire the ancients' track, aspire to tread the Confucian gate's path, and request to compile and gather writing from antiquity—taking Xu Shen's Shuowen as chief, also gathering Kong clan Documents, Five Classics phonetic glosses, Zhou primer, Erya, Sancang, Fanjiang, Fangyan, Tongsu wen, Zuwenzong, [12] Picao, Guangya, Ancient-and-Modern Character Glosses, three-script stone classic, Zilin, Rhyme Collection, and characters from various rhapsodies having the meaning of the six scripts—all arranged by category in sequence, texts without duplication, corrected into one work.
translations.idiomatic: Having exhausted my foolish shortcoming, wishing to stop yet unable, therefore I dare borrow the resources of six generations, respectfully follow my ancestors' instruction, privately admire the ancients' track, aspire to tread the Confucian gate's path, and request to compile and gather writing from antiquity—taking Xu Shen's Shuowen as chief, also gathering Kong clan Documents, Five Classics phonetic glosses, Zhou primer, Erya, Sancang, Fanjiang, Fangyan, Tongsu wen, Zuwenzong, [12] Picao, Guangya, Ancient-and-Modern Character Glosses, three-script stone classic, Zilin, Rhyme Collection, and characters from various rhapsodies having the meaning of the six scripts—all arranged by category in sequence, texts without duplication, corrected into one work.

sentences.zh: 其古籕、奇惑、俗隸諸體，咸使班於篆下，各有區別。

translations.literal: Ancient Zhou, odd, variant, vulgar, and clerical forms—all shall be arranged below seal script, each with distinction.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient Zhou, odd, variant, vulgar, and clerical forms—all shall be arranged below seal script, each with distinction.

sentences.zh: 詁訓假借之誼，僉隨文而解；

translations.literal: The meanings of glosses and loan characters—all shall follow the text in explanation;
translations.idiomatic: The meanings of glosses and loan characters—all shall follow the text in explanation;

sentences.zh: 音讀楚、夏之聲，並逐字而注。

translations.literal: readings of Chu and Xia sounds—all noted character by character.
translations.idiomatic: readings of Chu and Xia sounds—all noted character by character.

sentences.zh: 其所不知者則闕如也。

translations.literal: What is not known shall be left blank.
translations.idiomatic: What is not known shall be left blank.

sentences.zh: 脫蒙遂許，冀省百氏之觀，而同文字之域，典書祕書。

translations.literal: If I receive permission, I hope to reduce the views of the hundred schools and unify the domain of writing—canon books and secret archives.
translations.idiomatic: If I receive permission, I hope to reduce the views of the hundred schools and unify the domain of writing—canon books and secret archives.

sentences.zh: 所須之書，乞垂敕給；

translations.literal: The books needed—I beg your command to grant them;
translations.idiomatic: The books needed—I beg your command to grant them;

sentences.zh: 并學士五人嘗習文字者，助臣披覽；

translations.literal: and five erudites who have practiced writing to assist your servant in perusal;
translations.idiomatic: and five erudites who have practiced writing to assist your servant in perusal;

sentences.zh: 書生五人，專令抄寫。

translations.literal: five scribes solely for copying.
translations.idiomatic: five scribes solely for copying.

sentences.zh: 侍中、黃門、國子祭酒一月一監，評議疑隱，庶無紕繆。

translations.literal: Attendant-in-Ordinary, Yellow Gate, and Chancellor of the Imperial Academy once a month to supervise, discussing doubtful points, hoping for no error.
translations.idiomatic: The Attendant-in-Ordinary, Yellow Gate, and Chancellor of the Imperial Academy would supervise once a month, discussing doubtful points, hoping for no error.

sentences.zh: 所撰名目，伏聽明旨。

translations.literal: The title of what is composed—I respectfully await the bright decree.
translations.idiomatic: The title of the work to be composed—I respectfully await the bright decree.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「可如所請，并就太常，冀兼教八書史也。

translations.literal: An edict said, "As requested, and also go to the Minister of Ceremonies—Ji shall also teach the eight-script clerks.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "As requested, and also go to the Minister of Ceremonies—Ji shall also teach the eight-script clerks.

sentences.zh: 其有所須，依請給之。

translations.literal: What is needed shall be granted as requested.
translations.idiomatic: What is needed shall be granted as requested.

sentences.zh: 名目待書成重聞。」

translations.literal: The title shall be reported again when the book is complete."
translations.idiomatic: The title shall be reported again when the book is complete."

sentences.zh: 式於是撰集字書，號曰古今文字，凡四十卷，大體依許氏說文為本，上篆下隸。

translations.literal: Shi thereupon compiled and gathered a book of characters, titled Ancient and Modern Writing, forty scrolls in all, largely following Xu Shen's Shuowen as foundation, seal script above and clerical below.
translations.idiomatic: Shi thereupon compiled a book of characters, titled Ancient and Modern Writing, forty scrolls in all, largely following Xu Shen's Shuowen as foundation, with seal script above and clerical below.

sentences.zh: 又除宣威將軍、符璽郎，尋加輕車將軍。

translations.literal: He was also removed to General Who Proclaims Might and Director of Seals and Credentials; soon after he was additionally appointed General of Light Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: He was also appointed General Who Proclaims Might and Director of Seals and Credentials; soon after he was additionally appointed General of Light Chariots.

sentences.zh: 正光中，除驍騎將軍、兼著作佐郎，正史中字。

translations.literal: In Zhengguang he was appointed General of Valiant Cavalry and Concurrent Associate Compiler of the Standard History, correcting characters in the standard history.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengguang he was appointed General of Valiant Cavalry and Concurrent Associate Compiler of the Standard History, correcting characters in the standard history.

sentences.zh: 四年卒，贈右將軍、巴州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he died; posthumously granted General of the Right and Governor of Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he died; posthumously granted General of the Right and Governor of Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 其書竟未能成。

translations.literal: His book ultimately could not be completed.
translations.idiomatic: His book ultimately could not be completed.

sentences.zh: 式兄子征虜將軍順和，亦工篆書。

translations.literal: Shi's elder brother's son Shunhe, General Who Punishes Barbarians, was also skilled at seal script.
translations.idiomatic: Shi's elder brother's son Shunhe, General Who Punishes Barbarians, was also skilled at seal script.

sentences.zh: 先是太和中，兗州人沈法會能隸書，世宗之在東宮，敕法會侍書。

translations.literal: Earlier in the Taihe era, Shen Fahui of Yanzhou could write clerical script; when Emperor Shizong was in the Eastern Palace, he ordered Fahui to attend in writing.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier in the Taihe era, Shen Fahui of Yanzhou could write clerical script; when Emperor Shizong was in the Eastern Palace, he ordered Fahui to attend in writing.

sentences.zh: 已後隸迹見知於閭里者甚眾，未有如崔浩之妙。

translations.literal: Afterward clerical traces known in the villages were very numerous; none matched Cui Hao's marvel.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward clerical traces known in the villages were very numerous; none matched Cui Hao's marvel.

sentences.zh: 周澹，京兆鄠人也。

translations.literal: Zhou Dan was a man of Hu in Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Dan was a native of Hu in Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 為人多方術，尤善醫藥，為太醫令。

translations.literal: As a man he had many methods, especially skilled at medicine, and was Director of the Imperial Physicians.
translations.idiomatic: As a man he had many methods, especially skilled at medicine, and served as Director of the Imperial Physicians.

sentences.zh: 太宗嘗苦風頭眩，澹治得愈，由此見寵，位至特進，賜爵成德侯。

translations.idiomatic: In Yansxing he reached the post of Director of Scattered Affairs.

sentences.zh: 李脩，字思祖，本陽平館陶人。

translations.idiomatic: Li Xiu, courtesy name Sizu, was originally a native of Guantao in Yangping.

translations.idiomatic: His father Liang in youth studied medical arts but could not thoroughly investigate them.

translations.idiomatic: In Emperor Shizu's time he fled to Liu Yilong at Pengcheng, then studied all formulas under the monk Sengtan; acupuncture and administered drugs—none without effect.

sentences.zh: 徐兗之間，多所救恤，四方疾苦，不遠千里，竟往從之。

translations.literal: Between Xu and Yan he saved and relieved many; suffering from all quarters, not fearing a thousand li, they ultimately went to him.
translations.idiomatic: Between Xu and Yan he saved and relieved many; sufferers from all quarters, not fearing a thousand li, ultimately went to him.

translations.literal: Liang greatly built a hall to lodge the sick, stopping carriage and litter below; when there were dead, he then coffined and buried them, personally going to condole.
translations.idiomatic: Liang greatly built a hall to lodge the sick, stopping carriage and litter below; when there were dead, he then coffined and buried them, personally going to condole.

sentences.zh: 其仁厚若此。

translations.idiomatic: His benevolence and generosity were like this.

sentences.zh: 累遷府參軍，督護本郡，士門宿官，咸相交昵，車馬金帛，酬賚無貲。

translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly rose to Staff Officer of the headquarters and Protector of his native commandery; officials of the noble clans of Shimmen all drew close to him; carriage, horses, gold, and silk—rewards and gifts without limit.

translations.idiomatic: Xiu's elder brother Yuansun followed Bi Zhongjing to Pingcheng, also following the father's profession but not reaching it.

translations.idiomatic: For merit he was granted the title Viscount of Yiping and appointed Attendant at Court.

translations.idiomatic: Xiu was roughly the same as his elder brother.

translations.idiomatic: Entering Daijing late, he successively held the post of Director of Scattered Affairs; for merit he was granted the title Viscount of Xiacai and moved to Supervisor of Attendants.

translations.idiomatic: In the Taihe era he was constantly within the forbidden precinct.

translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Gaozu and Empress Dowager Wenming were unwell, Xiu attended with needle and drug—treatment often had effect.

translations.idiomatic: Rewards repeatedly increased; carriage, robes, residence, and mansion were called fresh and splendid.

sentences.zh: 集諸學士及工書者百餘人，在東宮撰諸藥方百餘卷，皆行於世。

translations.literal: He gathered more than a hundred erudites and skilled writers in the Eastern Palace to compile more than a hundred scrolls of medical formulas—all circulated in the world.
translations.idiomatic: He gathered more than a hundred erudites and skilled writers in the Eastern Palace to compile more than a hundred scrolls of medical formulas—all circulated in the world.

translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Duke of Xianyang Gao Yun though nearly a hundred years old still had vigorous qi; Emperor Gaozu and Empress Dowager Wenming at the time ordered Xiu to examine and treat him.

translations.idiomatic: One day he reported that Yun's pulse was exhausted and qi slight—the great mandate not far.

translations.literal: Before long he indeed died.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he indeed died.

translations.idiomatic: Moving to Luoyang, he became General of the Vanguard and Director of the Imperial Physicians.

sentences.zh: 後數年，卒，贈威遠將軍、青州刺史。

translations.literal: Several years later he died; posthumously granted General of Awesome Distance and Governor of Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Several years later he died; posthumously granted General of Awesome Distance and Governor of Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 子天授，襲。

translations.literal: His son Tianshou succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: His son Tianshou succeeded.

sentences.zh: 汶陽令。

translations.literal: Magistrate of Wenyang.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrate of Wenyang.

sentences.zh: 醫術又不逮父。

translations.literal: Medical arts again did not reach the father.
translations.idiomatic: Medical arts again did not reach the father.

sentences.zh: 徐謇，字成伯，丹陽人。

translations.literal: Xu Jian, courtesy name Chengbo, was a man of Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Jian, courtesy name Chengbo, was a native of Danyang.

sentences.zh: 家本東莞，與兄文伯等皆善醫藥。

translations.literal: His family was originally from Dongguan; he and his elder brother Wenbo and others were all skilled at medicine.
translations.idiomatic: His family was originally from Dongguan; he and his elder brother Wenbo and others were all skilled at medicine.

translations.idiomatic: Jian thereupon went to Qingzhou; Murong Baiyao pacified Dongyang and captured him, memorializing to send him to the capital.

translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xianzu wished to test his ability; he placed sick people in a tent and had Jian feel their pulses through a partition—he deeply obtained the form of the disease and also knew color signs.

translations.idiomatic: He was made Director of Scattered Affairs; gradually promoted to Chief of the Inner Attendants.

translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozu later knew his ability; when moving to Luoyang he slightly increased his favor.

translations.idiomatic: When the body was slightly unwell, and the favored Consort Feng had illness, all were ordered to treat.

translations.idiomatic: He was also removed to Grand Master of Scattered Affairs, transferred to General of the Right and Attending Physician.

translations.literal: Jian wished to compound golden elixir for Emperor Gaozu, methods for extending years.
translations.idiomatic: Jian wished to compound golden elixir for Emperor Gaozu, methods for extending years.

translations.idiomatic: He then entered and dwelt on Song Mountain, gathering and preparing its materials; for years without success, he then stopped.

translations.idiomatic: The various princes, Prince of Xianyang Yuan Xi, and others each had separate gifts, reaching a thousand bolts.

translations.idiomatic: Following the journey to Ye, Emperor Gaozu still himself had relapses; Jian day and night attended at his side.

translations.idiomatic: His son Jian, courtesy name Jingsheng, small name Lingbao, succeeded to the title.

translations.idiomatic: Jian's younger brother Zhiyuan, Supervisor of Attendants.
